paraphrase_en: ["A choice or judgment made after consideration"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 决定，决策"]

examples.en: The committee reached a unanimous decision.
examples.zh: 委员会达成了一致决定。

paraphrase_en: ["To make something clear or understandable"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 解释，说明"]

examples.en: The teacher explained the math problem step by step.
examples.zh: 老师逐步解释了数学问题。

paraphrase_en: ["A male offspring"]

examples.en: He is the eldest son of the family.
examples.zh: 他是家里的长子。

paraphrase_en: ["To want and expect something to happen", "A feeling of desire for something to happen"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 希望，期望", "n. 希望，期望"]

examples.en: I hope to see you soon.
examples.zh: 我希望很快见到你。

examples.en: There is still hope for recovery.
examples.zh: 仍有康复的希望。

paraphrase_en: ["Flat and level; not having bumps or holes", "Used to emphasize something surprising or extreme", "To make something equal or level"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 平坦的，平的", "adv. 甚至，即使", "v. 使平坦，使相等"]

examples.en: The surface of the table is even.
examples.zh: 桌子的表面很平坦。

examples.en: Even a child can understand this.
examples.zh: 甚至小孩子都能理解这个。

examples.en: He evened the soil before planting.
examples.zh: 他在种植前把土壤弄平了。

paraphrase_en: ["To grow or advance to a more mature or effective state", "To create or expand something over time", "To begin to experience a problem or condition"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 发展，发育", "v. 开发，研制", "v. 患上，出现"]

examples.en: Children develop rapidly in their early years.
examples.zh: 孩子们在幼年时期发育很快。

examples.en: The company is developing a new product.
examples.zh: 公司正在开发新产品。

examples.en: He developed a bad cold after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后他患了重感冒。

paraphrase_en: ["The ability to see something or the range of vision", "An opinion or attitude", "To look at or regard something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 景色，视野", "n. 观点，看法", "v. 观看，看待"]

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain is breathtaking.
examples.zh: 山顶的景色令人叹为观止。

examples.en: In my view, this is the best solution.
examples.zh: 在我看来，这是最好的解决方案。

examples.en: View the painting from different angles.
examples.zh: 从不同角度观看这幅画。

paraphrase_en: ["The way in which two people or groups feel and behave toward each other", "A connection or association between things"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 关系，人际关系", "n. 关联，联系"]

examples.en: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
examples.zh: 他们和邻居关系很好。

examples.en: The relationship between diet and health is well-known.
examples.zh: 饮食和健康之间的关系是众所周知的。

paraphrase_en: ["To hold something and take it from one place to another", "To support the weight of something and move", "To have or bear something as a feature"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 携带，搬运", "v. 承载，运载", "v. 具有，带有"]

examples.en: Can you carry this box for me?
examples.zh: 你能帮我搬这个箱子吗？

examples.en: The bridge can carry heavy loads.
examples.zh: 这座桥能承载重物。

examples.en: Her words carry a lot of weight.
examples.zh: 她的话很有分量。

paraphrase_en: ["A populated area with a name and defined boundaries", "The commercial or central area of a town"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 镇，城镇", "n. 市中心，商业区"]

examples.en: He lives in a small town near the mountains.
examples.zh: 他住在山区附近的一个小镇。

examples.en: Let's meet in town after work.
examples.zh: 我们下班后在市中心见面。

paraphrase_en: ["A paved way for vehicles to travel on", "A route or course of action"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 公路，道路", "n. 途径，方法"]

examples.en: The road was blocked by fallen trees.
examples.zh: 道路被倒下的树挡住了。

examples.en: We are on the road to success.
examples.zh: 我们正在通往成功的道路上。

paraphrase_en: ["To operate and control a vehicle", "To propel or force something to move", "A journey in a car"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 驾驶", "v. 驱使，推动", "n. 驾车出行"]

examples.en: She drives to work every day.
examples.zh: 她每天开车去上班。

examples.en: He drives the nail into the wall.
examples.zh: 他把钉子钉进墙里。

examples.en: We had a pleasant drive through the countryside.
examples.zh: 我们在乡间愉快地驾车出游。

paraphrase_en: ["Each of the two upper limbs of the human body.", "A branch or division of an organization.", "To supply with weapons."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 手臂", "n. 分支；部门", "v. 武装；装备"]

examples.en: She waved her arm to get attention.
examples.zh: 她挥动手臂引起注意。

examples.en: The finance arm of the company handles all accounts.
examples.zh: 公司的财务部门处理所有账目。

examples.en: The rebels armed themselves with rifles.
examples.zh: 叛军用步枪武装自己。

paraphrase_en: ["In accordance with fact or reality.", "Loyal or faithful."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 真实的；正确的", "adj. 忠实的；忠诚的"]

examples.en: It is true that the earth revolves around the sun.
examples.zh: 地球围绕太阳转是真实的。

examples.en: He is a true friend.
examples.zh: 他是一个忠实的朋友。

paraphrase_en: ["Relating to or involving a central government as distinguished from individual states or provinces."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 联邦的"]

examples.en: The federal system distributes power between national and state governments.
examples.zh: 联邦制在国家和州政府之间分配权力。

paraphrase_en: ["To separate into pieces as a result of a blow, shock, or strain.", "To interrupt or end something.", "A pause or gap in activity."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 打破；折断", "v. 中断；结束", "n. 休息；暂停"]

examples.en: Be careful not to break the glass.
examples.zh: 小心不要打破玻璃。

examples.en: The news broke his heart.
examples.zh: 这消息伤了他的心。

examples.en: Let's take a short break.
examples.zh: 让我们短暂休息一下。

paraphrase_en: ["Comparative of good; of a higher standard or quality.", "In a more excellent or effective manner."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 更好的", "adv. 更好地"]

examples.en: This solution is better than the previous one.
examples.zh: 这个解决方案比前一个更好。

examples.en: She sings better than I do.
examples.zh: 她唱歌比我好。

paraphrase_en: ["The state of being unlike or distinct.", "A point of disagreement."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 差异", "n. 分歧"]

examples.en: There's a noticeable difference in color.
examples.zh: 颜色上有明显的差异。

examples.en: They had differences over the policy.
examples.zh: 他们在政策上有分歧。

paraphrase_en: ["To express gratitude to someone."]

examples.en: Thank you for coming to my party.
examples.zh: 谢谢你来参加我的派对。

paraphrase_en: ["To be given or presented with something.", "To experience or be subjected to something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 收到", "v. 遭受；受到"]

examples.en: I received an email this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上收到了一封电子邮件。

examples.en: The project received widespread criticism.
examples.zh: 该项目受到了广泛批评。

paraphrase_en: ["The worth, importance, or usefulness of something.", "Principles or standards of behavior.", "To estimate the worth of something; to have a high opinion of."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 价值", "n. 价值观", "v. 评价；重视"]

examples.en: The value of education cannot be overstated.
examples.zh: 教育的价值怎么强调都不为过。

examples.en: Honesty is a fundamental value.
examples.zh: 诚实是一个基本的价值观。

examples.en: I value my family above all else.
examples.zh: 我重视我的家人胜过一切。

paraphrase_en: ["Relating to or involving two or more countries."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 国际的"]

examples.en: The United Nations is an international organization.
examples.zh: 联合国是一个国际组织。

paraphrase_en: ["- a structure with a roof and walls, such as a house or factory", "- the process or business of constructing something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. - 建筑物，房屋", "n. - 建筑，建造"]

examples.en: The new building has 20 floors.
examples.zh: 这座新建筑有20层。

examples.en: Building the bridge took five years.
examples.zh: 建造这座桥花了五年时间。

paraphrase_en: ["- the fact or process of doing something, typically to achieve an aim", "- a thing done; a deed"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. - 行动，行为", "n. - 作用，效果"]

examples.en: We need to take action to solve this problem.
examples.zh: 我们需要采取行动来解决这个问题。

examples.en: The action of the medicine is fast.
examples.zh: 这种药的作用很快。

paraphrase_en: ["- containing as much or as many as is possible or normal", "- having had enough to eat or drink"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. - 满的，充满的", "adj. - 吃饱的，喝足的"]

examples.en: The glass is full of water.
examples.zh: 杯子里装满了水。

examples.en: I'm full after that big meal.
examples.zh: 那顿大餐后我饱了。

paraphrase_en: ["- a three-dimensional representation of a person or thing, especially on a smaller scale", "- a system or thing used as an example to follow or imitate", "- a person employed to display clothes by wearing them"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. - 模型，雏形", "n. - 模范，典范", "n. - 模特"]

examples.en: He built a model of the solar system for his project.
examples.zh: 他为项目制作了一个太阳系模型。

examples.en: Her behavior is a model for others to follow.
examples.zh: 她的行为是其他人效仿的典范。

examples.en: She works as a fashion model in Paris.
examples.zh: 她在巴黎担任时装模特。

paraphrase_en: ["- to connect or link together", "- to become a member of a group or organization"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. - 连接，结合", "v. - 加入，参加"]

examples.en: Join the two pieces of wood with glue.
examples.zh: 用胶水把这两块木头连接起来。

examples.en: She decided to join the club to meet new people.
examples.zh: 她决定加入俱乐部以结识新朋友。

paraphrase_en: ["- each of the four divisions of the year (spring, summer, autumn, winter) associated with a particular type of weather", "- a period of the year when a particular activity or event is common"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. - 季节（春、夏、秋、冬）", "n. - 赛季；旺季"]

examples.en: Autumn is my favorite season.
examples.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

examples.en: The holiday season is very busy for retailers.
examples.zh: 假日季节对零售商来说非常繁忙。

paraphrase_en: ["- the community of people living in a particular country or region and having shared customs, laws, and organizations", "- a club or association formed for a particular purpose"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. - 社会", "n. - 协会，学会"]

examples.en: Modern society values individual freedom.
examples.zh: 现代社会重视个人自由。

examples.en: He joined the historical society to learn more about local history.
examples.zh: 他加入了历史协会以了解更多当地历史。

paraphrase_en: ["- for the reason that; since"]
paraphrase_zh: ["conj. - 因为"]

examples.en: I stayed home because I was feeling sick.
examples.zh: 我待在家里因为我感觉不舒服。

paraphrase_en: ["- a compulsory financial charge imposed by a government on individuals or businesses", "- to impose a tax on something"]

examples.en: The government increased taxes on luxury goods.
examples.zh: 政府提高了奢侈品税。

examples.en: The new policy will tax carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 新政策将对碳排放征税。

paraphrase_en: ["- a person who is in charge of an activity, department, or organization", "- a person who supervises the creative aspects of a motion picture or play"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. - 主管，董事，指导者", "n. - （电影、戏剧等的）导演"]

examples.en: She is the director of marketing at the company.
examples.zh: 她是公司的营销主管。

examples.en: The director won an Oscar for best director.
examples.zh: 这位导演赢得了奥斯卡最佳导演奖。

paraphrase_en: ["Before the usual or expected time.", "Happening or done before the usual or expected time."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 早地，提前", "adj. 早的，早期的"]

examples.en: She arrived early for the meeting.
examples.zh: 她提前到了会议。

examples.en: It's too early to make a decision.
examples.zh: 现在做决定还为时过早。

paraphrase_en: ["A place where someone or something is located or has been put.", "A particular way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.", "A job or role in an organization."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 位置，地点", "n. 姿势，姿态", "n. 职位，地位"]

examples.en: The hotel is in a central position in the city.
examples.zh: 酒店位于城市的中心位置。

examples.en: Please adjust your sitting position.
examples.zh: 请调整你的坐姿。

examples.en: She applied for the position of manager.
examples.zh: 她申请了经理职位。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who plays a game or sport.", "A person who plays a musical instrument.", "A device for playing recorded audio or video."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 运动员，选手", "n. 演奏者", "n. 播放器"]

examples.en: He is a skilled basketball player.
examples.zh: 他是一位熟练的篮球运动员。

examples.en: The piano player performed beautifully.
examples.zh: 钢琴演奏者表演得很出色。

examples.en: I need to buy a new DVD player.
examples.zh: 我需要买一个新的DVD播放器。

paraphrase_en: ["To have the same opinion; to concur.", "To say that one will do something or that something is acceptable; to consent.", "To be consistent or compatible."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 同意，赞同", "v. 答应，应允", "v. 一致，相符"]

examples.en: I agree with your decision.
examples.zh: 我同意你的决定。

examples.en: He agreed to help us.
examples.zh: 他答应帮助我们。

examples.en: The data does not agree with the hypothesis.
examples.zh: 数据与假设不一致。

paraphrase_en: ["To a great extent; very much.", "For a particular purpose; more than usual."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 特别，尤其", "adv. 专门地"]

examples.en: I love all fruits, especially apples.
examples.zh: 我喜欢所有水果，尤其是苹果。

examples.en: She made this cake especially for you.
examples.zh: 她特意为你做了这个蛋糕。

paraphrase_en: ["A piece of evidence or information constituting an account of something that has occurred, been done, or happened.", "A thin plastic disc carrying recorded sound in grooves on each surface, for reproduction by a record player.", "To set down in writing or other permanent form for later reference."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 记录，记载", "n. 唱片", "v. 记录，录制"]

examples.en: Keep a record of all expenses.
examples.zh: 保存所有开支的记录。

examples.en: She has a large collection of vinyl records.
examples.zh: 她收藏了大量的黑胶唱片。

examples.en: Please record the meeting for me.
examples.zh: 请为我录下会议内容。

paraphrase_en: ["To choose or select from a number of alternatives.", "To remove something from a surface or from among other things using one's fingers or a tool."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 选择，挑选", "v. 采摘，拾取"]

examples.en: You can pick any book you like.
examples.zh: 你可以挑选你喜欢的任何书。

examples.en: He picked the flowers from the garden.
examples.zh: 他从花园里摘了花。

paraphrase_en: ["To have on one's body as clothing, decoration, or protection.", "To damage or erode by use or friction.", "Clothing of a particular type or for a particular occasion."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 穿着，戴着", "v. 磨损，用旧", "n. 服装，穿戴物"]

examples.en: She wears a blue dress today.
examples.zh: 她今天穿着一条蓝色裙子。

examples.en: The constant use has worn out the tires.
examples.zh: 持续使用使轮胎磨损了。

examples.en: Casual wear is acceptable for the event.
examples.zh: 这个活动可以穿便装。

paraphrase_en: ["Material manufactured in thin sheets from the pulp of wood or other fibrous substances, used for writing, printing, or wrapping.", "A newspaper.", "An academic article or essay."]

examples.en: Please give me a sheet of paper.
examples.zh: 请给我一张纸。

examples.en: I read about it in the paper.
examples.zh: 我在报纸上读到了这件事。

examples.en: He published a paper in a scientific journal.
examples.zh: 他在科学期刊上发表了一篇论文。

paraphrase_en: ["Distinguished by some unusual quality; not ordinary or typical.", "A thing, such as an event, product, or broadcast, that is designed or organized for a particular occasion or purpose."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 特殊的，特别的", "n. 特别节目，特价商品"]

examples.en: She is a special person to me.
examples.zh: 她对我来说是个特别的人。

examples.en: The TV station is airing a special tonight.
examples.zh: 电视台今晚播放特别节目。

paraphrase_en: ["A continuous area or expanse; outer space; an interval of time", "To arrange items with intervals between them"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 空间，空地；太空；一段时间", "v. 隔开，留间隔"]

examples.en: There is a parking space over there.
examples.zh: 那边有一个停车位。

examples.en: Space the words evenly on the line.
examples.zh: 在行上均匀地排列单词。

paraphrase_en: ["The solid surface of the earth; a basis or foundation for something", "To establish a basis for; to cause a ship to run aground"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 地面，土地；基础，根据", "v. 以...为基础；使搁浅"]

examples.en: The ball rolled on the ground.
examples.zh: 球在地上滚动。

examples.en: His argument is grounded in facts.
examples.zh: 他的论点以事实为根据。

paraphrase_en: ["The shape, structure, or appearance of something; a type or kind", "To create or make something; to come into being"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 形状，结构；形式，类型", "v. 形成，构成；产生"]

examples.en: The form of the sculpture is unique.
examples.zh: 雕塑的形状很独特。

examples.en: Ice forms on the lake in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天湖面上会结冰。

paraphrase_en: ["To hold up or bear the weight of; to provide assistance or encouragement", "The act of helping or encouraging; a thing that bears weight"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 支撑，支持；援助，鼓励", "n. 支持，帮助；支撑物"]

examples.en: The bridge supports heavy traffic.
examples.zh: 这座桥支撑着繁忙的交通。

examples.en: Thank you for your support.
examples.zh: 感谢你的支持。

paraphrase_en: ["Something that happens or takes place; a planned occasion or activity"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 事件；活动，赛事"]

examples.en: The concert was a memorable event.
examples.zh: 音乐会是一次难忘的活动。

paraphrase_en: ["Relating to an authority or organization in a formal way", "A person who holds a position of authority or trust"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 官方的，正式的", "n. 官员，高级职员"]

examples.en: This is an official statement.
examples.zh: 这是一份官方声明。

examples.en: The government official announced the new policy.
examples.zh: 政府官员宣布了新政策。

paraphrase_en: ["Belonging to whom", "Of whom or which"]
paraphrase_zh: ["pron. 谁的", "det. 谁的，哪个的"]

examples.en: Whose book is this?
examples.zh: 这是谁的书？

examples.en: The man whose car was stolen reported it.
examples.zh: 车被偷的那个男人报告了这件事。

paraphrase_en: ["A subject or topic; physical substance", "To be important or significant"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 事情，问题；物质", "v. 重要，要紧"]

examples.en: This is a serious matter.
examples.zh: 这是一件严肃的事情。

examples.en: It doesn't matter what you think.
examples.zh: 你怎么想并不重要。

paraphrase_en: ["Every person; all people"]
paraphrase_zh: ["pron. 每个人；所有人"]

examples.en: Everyone is invited to the party.
examples.zh: 每个人都被邀请参加派对。

paraphrase_en: ["The middle point or part of something", "To place something at the center"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 中心，中央", "v. 集中，居中"]

examples.en: The city center is bustling with activity.
examples.zh: 市中心充满了繁忙的活动。

examples.en: Center the image on the page.
examples.zh: 将图像居中放在页面上。

paraphrase_en: ["Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship", "A small number of things"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 夫妇", "n. 几个"]

examples.en: The couple celebrated their anniversary.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇庆祝了他们的周年纪念日。

examples.en: I have a couple of questions.
examples.zh: 我有几个问题。

paraphrase_en: ["An area of ground on which something is located", "A place where a particular event happened"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 地点", "n. 遗址"]

examples.en: This is the site for the new building.
examples.zh: 这是新建筑的地点。

examples.en: We visited the historical site.
examples.zh: 我们参观了历史遗址。

paraphrase_en: ["The final part of something", "A goal or result", "To come or bring to a final point"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 结尾", "n. 目的", "v. 结束"]

examples.en: The end of the book was surprising.
examples.zh: 书的结尾令人惊讶。

examples.en: He achieved his end.
examples.zh: 他达到了目的。

examples.en: The meeting will end at noon.
examples.zh: 会议将在中午结束。

paraphrase_en: ["A planned piece of work that has a specific purpose", "A housing development", "To estimate or forecast"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 项目", "n. 住宅区", "v. 预测"]

examples.en: We are working on a new project.
examples.zh: 我们正在做一个新项目。

examples.en: The project includes 100 homes.
examples.zh: 这个住宅区包括100套住房。

examples.en: The company projects a 10% growth.
examples.zh: 公司预测增长10%。

paraphrase_en: ["To strike something with force", "To reach a particular level or point", "A successful song, movie, etc."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 击打", "v. 达到", "n. 热门作品"]

examples.en: He hit the ball with a bat.
examples.zh: 他用球棒击球。

examples.en: The temperature hit 30 degrees.
examples.zh: 温度达到了30度。

examples.en: The song became a hit.
examples.zh: 这首歌成了热门作品。

paraphrase_en: ["The lowest part or edge of something", "A main place where a person or organization lives or works", "To use something as the foundation"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 底部", "n. 基地", "v. 以...为基础"]

examples.en: The base of the mountain is covered in snow.
examples.zh: 山的底部覆盖着雪。

examples.en: The army set up a base in the area.
examples.zh: 军队在该地区设立了一个基地。

examples.en: The theory is based on scientific evidence.
examples.zh: 该理论基于科学证据。

paraphrase_en: ["A thing that a person or group does", "The state of being active"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 活动", "n. 活动性"]

examples.en: Swimming is a popular activity.
examples.zh: 游泳是一项受欢迎的活动。

examples.en: There was a lot of activity in the market.
examples.zh: 市场上有很多活动。

paraphrase_en: ["A celestial body that emits light", "A famous person, especially in entertainment"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 星星", "n. 明星"]

examples.en: The night sky is full of stars.
examples.zh: 夜空中布满了星星。

examples.en: She is a movie star.
examples.zh: 她是一位电影明星。

paraphrase_en: ["A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs", "A set of facts or figures systematically displayed"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 桌子", "n. 表格"]

examples.en: We sat at the table for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们坐在桌边吃晚饭。

examples.en: Please check the table for the results.
examples.zh: 请查看表格以获取结果。

paraphrase_en: ["To require something because it is essential", "Something that is necessary"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 需要", "n. 需要"]

examples.en: I need water to survive.
examples.zh: 我需要水来生存。

examples.en: There is a need for change.
examples.zh: 需要改变。

paraphrase_en: ["a place where legal cases are heard and decided.", "an area or space for playing certain sports.", "to seek to gain favor, affection, or support from someone."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(名词) 法院；法庭。", "(名词) 球场；场地。", "(动词) 追求；争取。"]

examples.en: The defendant appeared in court for the trial.
examples.zh: 被告出庭受审。

examples.en: They reserved a tennis court for the weekend.
examples.zh: 他们预订了一个网球场供周末使用。

examples.en: He is courting investors to fund his startup.
examples.zh: 他正在争取投资者为他的初创公司提供资金。

paraphrase_en: ["to make, manufacture, or create something.", "agricultural products, especially fruits and vegetables."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(动词) 生产；制造。", "(名词) 农产品（尤指水果和蔬菜）。"]

examples.en: The factory produces thousands of units daily.
examples.zh: 工厂每天生产数千个单位。

examples.en: The farmer's market offers fresh, organic produce.
examples.zh: 农贸市场提供新鲜的有机农产品。

paraphrase_en: ["to consume food by putting it into the mouth, chewing, and swallowing."]

examples.en: We usually eat breakfast together as a family.
examples.zh: 我们通常一家人一起吃早餐。

paraphrase_en: ["relating to the United States of America.", "a native or citizen of the United States."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(形容词) 美国的。", "(名词) 美国人。"]

examples.en: American football is popular in the U.S.
examples.zh: 美式足球在美国很受欢迎。

examples.en: Many Americans celebrate Thanksgiving in November.
examples.zh: 许多美国人在十一月庆祝感恩节。

paraphrase_en: ["to impart knowledge or skills to someone through instruction."]

examples.en: She teaches mathematics to high school students.
examples.zh: 她教高中生数学。

paraphrase_en: ["a viscous liquid derived from petroleum, used as fuel or lubricant.", "to apply oil to something for lubrication or protection."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(名词) 石油；油。", "(动词) 上油；涂油。"]

examples.en: Global oil prices fluctuate based on supply and demand.
examples.zh: 全球石油价格根据供需波动。

examples.en: Remember to oil the hinges to prevent squeaking.
examples.zh: 记得给铰链上油以防止吱吱声。

paraphrase_en: ["one of two equal parts of something.", "amounting to half of a whole.", "to the extent of fifty percent."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(名词) 一半。", "(形容词) 半个的。", "(副词) 到一半的程度。"]

examples.en: She divided the cake into halves.
examples.zh: 她把蛋糕分成两半。

examples.en: He ate only a half sandwich for lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐他只吃了半个三明治。

examples.en: The bottle is half empty.
examples.zh: 瓶子空了一半。

paraphrase_en: ["a set of circumstances or conditions in which one finds oneself."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(名词) 情况；处境。"]

examples.en: The political situation in the country is stable.
examples.zh: 该国的政治局势稳定。

paraphrase_en: ["not difficult; requiring little effort or skill."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(形容词) 容易的；不费力的。"]

examples.en: The instructions are clear and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 说明清晰易懂。

paraphrase_en: ["the amount of money needed to buy or do something.", "to require a specified payment, expenditure, or effort."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(名词) 成本, 费用。", "(动词) 花费。"]

examples.en: The cost of living has increased significantly.
examples.zh: 生活成本大幅增加了。

examples.en: The new software will cost the company over a million dollars.
examples.zh: 新软件将花费公司超过一百万美元。

paraphrase_en: ["Economic activity concerned with the processing of raw materials and manufacture of goods", "A particular branch of economic or commercial activity"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 工业；产业", "n. 行业；企业"]

examples.en: The manufacturing industry is vital to the economy.
examples.zh: 制造业对经济至关重要。

examples.en: She works in the tourism industry.
examples.zh: 她在旅游业工作。

paraphrase_en: ["A number, especially one that is official or important", "The shape of the human body", "To calculate or think that something is true"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 数字；人物", "n. 身材；体形", "v. 认为；计算"]

examples.en: The sales figures are impressive.
examples.zh: 销售数字令人印象深刻。

examples.en: She has a slender figure.
examples.zh: 她身材苗条。

examples.en: I figure he'll be late.
examples.zh: 我想他会迟到。

paraphrase_en: ["The front part of the head from the forehead to the chin", "An expression on someone's face", "To confront or deal with something difficult"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 脸；面部", "n. 表情；面容", "v. 面对；面向"]

examples.en: She has a beautiful face.
examples.zh: 她有一张漂亮的脸。

examples.en: His face showed surprise.
examples.zh: 他的脸上露出惊讶的表情。

examples.en: We must face the truth.
examples.zh: 我们必须面对现实。

paraphrase_en: ["A paved public road in an urban area, typically with buildings on one or both sides"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 街道；大街"]

examples.en: We walked down the main street.
examples.zh: 我们沿着主街走去。

paraphrase_en: ["A representation of a person or thing in art, such as a painting or photograph", "The general impression that a person, organization, or product presents to the public"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 图像；形象", "n. 形象；印象"]

examples.en: The satellite captured an image of the Earth.
examples.zh: 卫星捕捉到了地球的图像。

examples.en: The company is trying to improve its public image.
examples.zh: 公司正试图改善其公众形象。

paraphrase_en: ["A reflexive form of 'it,' used for emphasis or to refer back to the subject"]
paraphrase_zh: ["pron. 它自己；自身"]

examples.en: The cat cleaned itself.
examples.zh: 猫清洁了自己。

paraphrase_en: ["A device used for voice communication over distances", "To contact someone by telephone"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 电话；手机", "v. 打电话"]

examples.en: My phone is ringing.
examples.zh: 我的电话响了。

examples.en: I'll phone you later.
examples.zh: 我晚点会打电话给你。

paraphrase_en: ["/pronoun: one or the other of two people or things", "Used before the first of two or more alternatives"]
paraphrase_zh: ["限定词/pron. （两者中的）任何一个；每个", "conj. 或者；要么"]

examples.en: You can choose either option.
examples.zh: 你可以选择任一选项。

examples.en: Either we leave now or we stay here.
examples.zh: 要么我们现在离开，要么我们留在这里。

paraphrase_en: ["Facts and statistics collected together for reference or analysis", "Information in digital form that can be transmitted or processed"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 数据；资料", "n. 数据（计算机处理中的）"]

examples.en: The scientist analyzed the data from the experiment.
examples.zh: 科学家分析了实验中的数据。

examples.en: The data is stored on a secure server.
examples.zh: 数据存储在安全的服务器上。

paraphrase_en: ["To place something over or upon something else to protect or hide it", "Something that lies over, upon, or around something else, especially for protection or concealment"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 覆盖；遮盖", "n. 封面；盖子"]

examples.en: She used a blanket to cover the sofa.
examples.zh: 她用毯子盖住沙发。

examples.en: The book has a beautiful cover.
examples.zh: 这本书有一个漂亮的封面。

paraphrase_en: ["To a considerable extent; fairly", "Completely; entirely"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adverb: 相当；颇", "adverb: 完全；十分"]

examples.en: The test was quite difficult.
examples.zh: 测试相当难。

examples.en: I'm quite finished with my work.
examples.zh: 我的工作完全完成了。

paraphrase_en: ["A visual representation such as a painting or photograph", "To form a mental image of something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["noun: 图画；照片", "verb: 想象；描绘"]

examples.en: The picture on the wall is a famous painting.
examples.zh: 墙上的画是一幅名画。

examples.en: Picture yourself achieving your goals.
examples.zh: 想象一下你实现目标的情景。

paraphrase_en: ["Transparent; allowing light to pass through", "Easy to understand or perceive", "To remove obstructions or make free from"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adjective: 清澈的；透明的", "adjective: 清楚的；清晰的", "verb: 清除；清理"]

examples.en: The clear sky indicated good weather.
examples.zh: 晴朗的天空预示着好天气。

examples.en: The message was clear and concise.
examples.zh: 信息清晰简洁。

examples.en: We need to clear the road after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨后我们需要清理道路。

paraphrase_en: ["The actual use or application of a method", "Repeated exercise to gain skill", "To do something regularly to improve"]
paraphrase_zh: ["noun: 实践；惯例", "noun: 练习；训练", "verb: 练习；实践"]

examples.en: In theory, it sounds good, but practice is different.
examples.zh: 理论上听起来不错，但实际应用不同。

examples.en: Daily practice is essential for learning a language.
examples.zh: 每天练习对学习语言至关重要。

examples.en: She practices yoga every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上练习瑜伽。

paraphrase_en: ["A portion or part of something", "A single item or instance", "A musical composition"]
paraphrase_zh: ["noun: 块；件", "noun: 件；个", "noun: 乐曲；作品"]

examples.en: He picked up a piece of paper.
examples.zh: 他捡起一张纸。

examples.en: This piece of information is crucial.
examples.zh: 这条信息至关重要。

examples.en: The pianist performed a classical piece.
examples.zh: 钢琴家演奏了一首古典乐曲。

paraphrase_en: ["The solid surface of the earth", "To come to rest on the ground after flight", "A country or region"]
paraphrase_zh: ["noun: 土地；陆地", "verb: 着陆；降落", "noun: 国家；地区"]

examples.en: The land was covered in snow.
examples.zh: 土地被雪覆盖。

examples.en: The bird landed on the branch.
examples.zh: 鸟儿落在树枝上。

examples.en: He traveled across many lands.
examples.zh: 他穿越了许多国家。

paraphrase_en: ["Having occurred or begun not long ago"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adjective: 最近的；近期的"]

examples.en: There have been several recent changes in the policy.
examples.zh: 政策最近有几项变动。

paraphrase_en: ["To give a detailed account in words"]
paraphrase_zh: ["verb: 描述；形容"]

examples.en: Please describe your experience in detail.
examples.zh: 请详细描述你的经历。

paraphrase_en: ["An item manufactured or produced for sale", "The result of a chemical reaction"]
paraphrase_zh: ["noun: 产品；商品", "noun: 产物"]

examples.en: The company launched a new product line.
examples.zh: 公司推出了一条新产品线。

examples.en: Carbon dioxide is a product of combustion.
examples.zh: 二氧化碳是燃烧的产物。

paraphrase_zh: ["noun: 医生", "verb: 篡改；伪造"]

examples.en: The doctor prescribed medication for my headache.
examples.zh: 医生给我开了治头痛的药。

examples.en: He was accused of doctoring the evidence.
examples.zh: 他被指控篡改证据。

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 墙，墙壁", "n. 屏障，壁垒"]

examples.en: The ancient city was surrounded by high walls.
examples.zh: 古城被高墙环绕。

examples.en: He hit a wall of resistance from the committee.
examples.zh: 他遇到了委员会的阻力。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who is receiving medical care", "Having or showing the capacity to accept or tolerate delays, problems, or suffering without becoming annoyed or anxious"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 病人，患者", "adj. 耐心的，忍耐的"]

examples.en: The patient was discharged from the hospital.
examples.zh: 病人出院了。

examples.en: You must be patient when teaching young children.
examples.zh: 教小孩子时必须有耐心。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who is employed or engaged in work, especially manual or industrial labor"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 工人，工作者"]

examples.en: The construction site was full of workers.
examples.zh: 工地上满是工人。

paraphrase_en: ["Information about recent events or happenings, especially as reported by media"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 新闻，消息"]

examples.en: The news of the discovery spread quickly.
examples.zh: 发现的消息迅速传播。

paraphrase_en: ["A procedure for critical evaluation", "An examination of knowledge or skill", "To take measures to check the quality or performance of something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 测试，试验", "n. 考试，测验", "v. 测试，考验"]

examples.en: The engineer performed a stress test on the bridge.
examples.zh: 工程师对桥梁进行了压力测试。

examples.en: She aced the math test.
examples.zh: 她数学考试得高分。

examples.en: We need to test the new software thoroughly.
examples.zh: 我们需要彻底测试新软件。

paraphrase_en: ["A motion picture; a film"]

examples.en: We decided to watch a movie at home.
examples.zh: 我们决定在家看电影。

paraphrase_en: ["Known for sure; established without doubt", "Specific but not identified or named", "Confident in one's knowledge or belief"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 确定的，确信的", "adj. 某些，某", "adj. 自信的，有把握的"]

examples.en: It is certain that the project will succeed.
examples.zh: 项目肯定会成功。

examples.en: Certain details are still unknown.
examples.zh: 某些细节仍未知。

examples.en: I'm certain about his abilities.
examples.zh: 我对他的能力有把握。

paraphrase_en: ["The direction in which a compass needle normally points", "Situated in or facing the north"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 北，北方", "adj. 北方的"]

examples.en: They headed north to escape the heat.
examples.zh: 他们向北避暑。

examples.en: The north side of the building gets more sunlight.
examples.zh: 建筑物的北侧阳光更充足。

paraphrase_en: ["A deep feeling of affection or attachment", "A strong liking or enthusiasm for something", "To feel deep affection for someone"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 爱，爱情", "n. 喜爱，热爱", "v. 爱，热爱"]

examples.en: The love between the couple was undeniable.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇之间的爱是不可否认的。

examples.en: She has a love for painting.
examples.zh: 她对绘画有热爱。

examples.en: I love spending time with my friends.
examples.zh: 我喜欢和朋友们在一起。

paraphrase_en: ["Relating to or concerning a person's private life, relationships, and emotions", "Done or made by a particular person rather than by someone else"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 个人的，私人的", "adj. 亲自的，本人的"]

examples.en: She keeps her personal life separate from her work.
examples.zh: 她将个人生活与工作分开。

examples.en: Please add a personal note to the letter.
examples.zh: 请在信中加上个人附言。

paraphrase_en: ["Allowing access or passage", "To move so as to allow access"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 开着的；开放的", "v. 打开"]

examples.en: The door is open.
examples.zh: 门开着。

examples.en: Please open the window.
examples.zh: 请打开窗户。

paraphrase_en: ["To bear the weight of or to give assistance", "The act of supporting"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 支持；支撑", "n. 支持；拥护"]

examples.en: I support your decision.
examples.zh: 我支持你的决定。

examples.en: Thank you for your support.
examples.zh: 谢谢你的支持。

paraphrase_en: ["In a straightforward manner", "Merely or only"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 简单地", "adv. 仅仅；只不过"]

examples.en: She explained the problem simply.
examples.zh: 她简单地解释了问题。

examples.en: It's simply a matter of time.
examples.zh: 这只是时间问题。

paraphrase_en: ["Coming after the second in order", "The third one in a series"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 第三的", "n. 第三"]

examples.en: This is the third time I've called.
examples.zh: 这是我第三次打电话了。

examples.en: He finished third in the race.
examples.zh: 他在比赛中获得了第三名。

paraphrase_en: ["The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 技术；科技"]

examples.en: Modern technology has changed our lives.
examples.zh: 现代科技改变了我们的生活。

paraphrase_en: ["To capture or seize something moving", "An act of catching something", "To become infected with an illness"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 接住；抓住", "n. 接球", "v. 染上（疾病）"]

examples.en: He caught the ball with one hand.
examples.zh: 他用一只手接住了球。

examples.en: That was a great catch!
examples.zh: 那次接球太棒了！

examples.en: I caught a cold last week.
examples.zh: 我上周感冒了。

paraphrase_en: ["A movement made by lifting the foot", "A stage in a process", "To move by lifting the foot"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 步；脚步", "n. 步骤", "v. 走；踏"]

examples.en: He took a step forward.
examples.zh: 他向前迈了一步。

examples.en: The first step is to gather information.
examples.zh: 第一步是收集信息。

examples.en: Please step inside.
examples.zh: 请进来。

paraphrase_en: ["A very young child or animal"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 婴儿；宝宝"]

examples.en: The baby is sleeping in the crib.
examples.zh: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡觉。

paraphrase_en: ["An electronic device for processing data"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 计算机；电脑"]

examples.en: She bought a new computer for her studies.
examples.zh: 她为学习买了一台新电脑。

paraphrase_en: ["A category of people or things with common characteristics", "To write something using a keyboard"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 类型；种类", "v. 打字"]

examples.en: This is a new type of computer.
examples.zh: 这是一种新型计算机。

examples.en: She typed the report quickly.
examples.zh: 她迅速打出了报告。

paraphrase_en: ["The act of concentrating on or being aware of something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 注意，关注"]

examples.en: Pay attention to the instructions.
examples.zh: 注意听指示。

paraphrase_en: ["To create a picture or diagram using lines and marks", "To pull or move something in a particular direction"]

examples.en: He likes to draw landscapes.
examples.zh: 他喜欢画风景画。

examples.en: She drew the chair closer to the table.
examples.zh: 她把椅子拉近桌子。

paraphrase_en: ["A movie or motion picture", "A thin layer or coating on a surface"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 电影", "n. 薄膜，薄层"]

examples.en: The film was very entertaining.
examples.zh: 这部电影非常有趣。

examples.en: A film of oil formed on the water.
examples.zh: 水面上形成了一层油膜。

paraphrase_en: ["A member or supporter of the Republican Party in the United States", "Relating to or characteristic of the Republican Party"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 共和党人", "adj. 共和党的"]

examples.en: The Republican candidate won the election.
examples.zh: 共和党候选人赢得了选举。

examples.en: Republican values include limited government.
examples.zh: 共和党的价值观包括有限政府。

paraphrase_en: ["A woody perennial plant with a single stem or trunk"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 树，树木"]

examples.en: We planted a tree in our backyard.
examples.zh: 我们在后院种了一棵树。

paraphrase_en: ["The origin or cause of something", "A person or thing that supplies information"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 来源，源头", "n. 消息来源，提供者"]

examples.en: The source of this pollution is the factory.
examples.zh: 这个污染的来源是工厂。

examples.en: Always cite your sources in academic writing.
examples.zh: 在学术写作中，始终引用你的来源。

paraphrase_en: ["Of the color of blood or fire", "The color red"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 红色的", "n. 红色"]

examples.en: The apple is red.
examples.zh: 这个苹果是红色的。

examples.en: Red symbolizes luck in Chinese culture.
examples.zh: 在中国文化中，红色象征着幸运。

paraphrase_en: ["Almost, not completely"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 几乎，差不多"]

examples.en: It's nearly time to go.
examples.zh: 差不多是时候走了。

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 组织，机构", "n. 组织，安排"]

examples.en: Climate change is a global issue.
examples.zh: 气候变化是一个全球性问题。

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 参议院"]

examples.zh: 参议院通过了新法案。

examples.zh: 政府实施了经济改革。

examples.zh: 他们正在努力改革教育体系。

paraphrase_en: ["The means of approaching or entering a place", "The right or opportunity to use or benefit from something", "To retrieve or gain entry to data or a system"]

examples.en: The access to the building was restricted.
examples.zh: 进入大楼的通道受到限制。

examples.en: Students have access to the library resources.
examples.zh: 学生可以使用图书馆资源。

examples.en: You can access the information online.
examples.zh: 你可以在线访问这些信息。

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 餐馆，饭店"]

examples.zh: 我们去了一家高档餐馆吃晚餐。

examples.zh: 法官判处罪犯十年监禁。

examples.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.
examples.zh: 不要以貌取人。

paraphrase_en: ["To prepare and issue a book, journal, etc., for sale", "To make information available to the public"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 出版，发行", "v. 公布，发表"]

examples.en: She published her first novel last year.
examples.zh: 她去年出版了她的第一本小说。

examples.en: The company published its annual report online.
examples.zh: 公司在其网站上公布了年度报告。

paraphrase_en: ["The amount of money needed to buy or do something", "To require the payment of money or effort"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 费用，成本", "v. 花费，使付出"]

examples.en: The cost of living has increased significantly.
examples.zh: 生活成本显著增加了。

examples.zh: 这个项目将花费很多钱。

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 关系, 联系", "n. 亲戚, 家属"]

examples.zh: 饮食与健康之间的关系是众所周知的。

examples.en: He is a distant relation of mine.
examples.zh: 他是我的一个远亲。

paraphrase_en: ["To find pleasant or enjoyable", "Similar to or resembling", "In the same way that"]

examples.zh: 我喜欢读书。

examples.zh: 她看起来像她的母亲。

examples.en: It looks like it's going to rain.
examples.zh: 看起来好像要下雨了。

paraphrase_en: ["To set free or allow to escape", "To make something available to the public", "The act of releasing or being released"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 释放, 放出", "v. 发行, 公布", "n. 释放, 发行"]

examples.en: They decided to release the hostages.
examples.zh: 他们决定释放人质。

examples.en: The company released a new smartphone.
examples.zh: 公司发布了一款新智能手机。

examples.en: The release of the movie was delayed.
examples.zh: 电影的发行被推迟了。

paraphrase_zh: ["v. 拥有, 持有", "adj. 自己的, 本人的"]

examples.en: She owns a beautiful house.
examples.zh: 她拥有一栋漂亮的房子。

examples.en: I saw it with my own eyes.
examples.zh: 我亲眼看到了。

paraphrase_en: ["A warm-blooded animal with wings and feathers that can usually fly"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 鸟, 禽类"]

examples.en: The bird sang in the tree.
examples.zh: 鸟儿在树上歌唱。

paraphrase_en: ["A personal view or belief about something", "A formal statement of advice by an expert"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 意见, 看法", "n. 鉴定, 专家意见"]

examples.en: In my opinion, the plan is feasible.
examples.zh: 在我看来，这个计划是可行的。

examples.en: The doctor's opinion was that she should rest.
examples.zh: 医生的意见是她应该休息。

paraphrase_en: ["A method of payment allowing purchase now and payment later", "Praise or recognition for an achievement", "To believe or accept something as true"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 信用, 信贷", "n. 荣誉, 赞扬", "v. 相信, 认为"]

examples.en: I bought the car on credit.
examples.zh: 我用信贷买了这辆车。

examples.en: She received credit for her hard work.
examples.zh: 她的辛勤工作得到了认可。

examples.en: I credit him with saving the company.
examples.zh: 我认为他拯救了公司。

paraphrase_en: ["Expressing adverse or disapproving judgments", "Of the greatest importance, crucial", "Involving careful analysis or judgment"]

examples.en: He is always critical of my work.
examples.zh: 他总是批评我的工作。

examples.en: Water is critical to survival.
examples.zh: 水对生存至关重要。

examples.en: Critical thinking is essential in science.
examples.zh: 批判性思维在科学中至关重要。

paraphrase_en: ["A point or area where lines or surfaces meet", "To drive or force into a difficult position"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 角落, 拐角", "v. 使陷入困境, 逼入角落"]

examples.en: The cat hid in the corner of the room.
examples.zh: 猫躲在房间的角落里。

examples.en: The police cornered the thief in an alley.
examples.zh: 警察把小偷逼到了死胡同里。

paraphrase_en: ["Worried or anxious", "Involved or interested in something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 担心的, 忧虑的", "adj. 有关的, 关心的"]

examples.en: She is concerned about her exam results.
examples.zh: 她担心她的考试成绩。

examples.en: The concerned authorities are looking into the matter.
examples.zh: 有关当局正在调查此事。

paraphrase_en: ["To remember something", "To call back or retrieve", "The act of remembering"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 回忆", "v. 召回", "n. 记忆"]

examples.en: I can't recall his name.
examples.zh: 我想不起他的名字。

examples.zh: 公司决定召回有缺陷的产品。

examples.en: Her recall of the event is vivid.
examples.zh: 她对事件的记忆很生动。

paraphrase_en: ["A particular form of something that differs from other forms", "An account of something from a specific perspective"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 版本", "n. 说法"]

examples.en: This is the latest version of the software.
examples.zh: 这是软件的最新版本。

examples.en: He told his version of the story.
examples.zh: 他讲述了自己版本的故事。

paraphrase_en: ["To look fixedly at something", "A long, steady look"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 盯着看", "n. 凝视"]

examples.en: Don't stare at strangers.
examples.zh: 不要盯着陌生人看。

examples.en: She gave him a cold stare.
examples.zh: 她冷冷地凝视了他一眼。

paraphrase_en: ["The condition of being protected from danger", "A device or measure to prevent harm"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 安全", "n. 安全措施"]

examples.en: Safety is our top priority.
examples.zh: 安全是我们的首要任务。

examples.en: Wear safety goggles in the lab.
examples.zh: 在实验室要戴安全护目镜。

paraphrase_en: ["Successful in producing a desired result", "In operation or force"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 有效的", "adj. 生效的"]

examples.en: The new policy is very effective.
examples.zh: 新政策非常有效。

examples.en: The law becomes effective next month.
examples.zh: 该法律下个月生效。

paraphrase_en: ["A local area where people live", "The surrounding area or vicinity"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 邻里", "n. 社区"]

examples.en: I grew up in a quiet neighborhood.
examples.zh: 我在一个安静的社区长大。

examples.en: There are many shops in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 附近有很多商店。

paraphrase_en: ["Existing from the beginning", "New and creative", "The first version of something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 原始的", "adj. 独创的", "n. 原件"]

examples.en: The original plan was changed.
examples.zh: 原始计划被改变了。

examples.en: She has an original idea.
examples.zh: 她有一个独创的想法。

examples.en: Please return the original document.
examples.zh: 请归还原件。

paraphrase_en: ["A formal decision or law", "A section of a play", "To do something"]

examples.en: The Congress passed a new act.
examples.zh: 国会通过了一项新法案。

examples.en: The second act of the play is dramatic.
examples.zh: 该剧的第二幕很戏剧性。

examples.en: He decided to act immediately.
examples.zh: 他决定立即行动。

paraphrase_en: ["A group of soldiers", "A large group of people or animals"]

examples.en: The troops were deployed to the border.
examples.zh: 军队被部署到边境。

examples.en: A troop of scouts went camping.
examples.zh: 一群童子军去露营。

paraphrase_en: ["Money received for work or investments", "Total earnings over a period"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 收入", "n. 收益"]

examples.zh: 她的月收入足够支付生活费用。

examples.en: The company's annual income increased by 10%.
examples.zh: 公司的年收入增长了10%。

paraphrase_en: ["Without changing direction or stopping.", "In a direct manner; exactly."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 直接地；径直地", "adv. 直截了当地；正好"]

examples.zh: 直接去办公室.

examples.zh: 他直接回答了问题.

paraphrase_zh: ["v. 使受伤；弄伤", "v. 伤害；使伤心"]

examples.en: He hurt his leg in the accident.
examples.zh: 他在事故中伤了腿.

examples.en: Her words hurt him deeply.
examples.zh: 她的话深深伤害了他.

paraphrase_en: ["A group of living organisms that can interbreed."]

examples.en: Many species are endangered due to habitat loss.
examples.zh: 许多物种因栖息地丧失而濒临灭绝.

paraphrase_en: ["Without delay; at once.", "Directly or closely."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 立即；马上", "adv. 直接地；紧接地"]

examples.en: Please respond immediately.
examples.zh: 请立即回复.

examples.en: He arrived immediately after the call.
examples.zh: 电话一打完他就到了.

examples.en: We followed the track through the forest.
examples.zh: 我们沿着小道穿过森林.

examples.en: The athletes ran on the track.
examples.zh: 运动员们在跑道上奔跑.

examples.en: The police tracked the suspect.
examples.zh: 警察追踪了嫌疑人.

paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 基本的；基础的", "adj. 初级的；根本的"]

examples.zh: 基础教育对发展至关重要.

examples.en: He has a basic understanding of the subject.
examples.zh: 他对这个科目有基本的了解.

examples.zh: 他用球棒击球.

examples.en: The workers went on strike.
examples.zh: 工人们举行罢工.

examples.en: The lightning struck the tree.
examples.zh: 闪电击中了那棵树.

paraphrase_en: ["A feeling of expectation and desire for a certain thing to happen.", "To want something to happen or be the case."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 希望；期望", "v. 希望；期望"]

examples.zh: 对更好的未来抱有希望.

examples.en: I hope you can come.
examples.zh: 我希望你能来.

paraphrase_en: ["The expanse of air over the earth; the atmosphere.", "The celestial sphere; heaven."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 天空", "n. 天际；天堂"]

examples.en: The sky was clear and blue.
examples.zh: 天空晴朗湛蓝.

examples.en: He looked up at the night sky.
examples.zh: 他仰望夜空.

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 自由；自主", "n. 自由权；自由度"]

examples.en: People fought for their freedom.
examples.zh: 人们为自由而战.

examples.en: She has the freedom to choose her career.
examples.zh: 她有选择职业的自由.

paraphrase_en: ["Completely; without any qualification", "Used to express strong agreement or affirmation"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 完全地；绝对地", "adv. 用于表示强烈同意或肯定"]

examples.en: I absolutely agree with you.
examples.zh: 我完全同意你的观点。

examples.en: Is it a good idea? Absolutely!
examples.zh: 这是个好主意吗？绝对！

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 几何学中的平面", "n. 飞机", "n. 用于刨平或成型木材的工具"]

examples.zh: 图表显示了一个三维空间中的平面。

examples.en: The plane landed safely.
examples.zh: 飞机安全着陆。

examples.en: He used a plane to smooth the table surface.
examples.zh: 他用刨子刨平桌面。

paraphrase_en: ["No person; not anyone", "A person of no importance or authority"]
paraphrase_zh: ["pron. 没有人；无人", "n. 无足轻重的人；无权无势的人"]

examples.zh: 我打电话时没人在家。

examples.zh: 在公司里，他被当作无足轻重的人对待。

paraphrase_en: ["To successfully bring about or reach a desired objective or result"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 成功实现或达到预期目标或结果"]

examples.en: She achieved her dream of becoming a doctor.
examples.zh: 她实现了成为医生的梦想。

paraphrase_en: ["A material thing that can be seen and touched", "A goal, aim, or purpose", "To express disapproval or opposition"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 可看到和触摸到的实物", "n. 目标，目的", "v. 表示反对或异议"]

examples.en: A shiny object caught her attention.
examples.zh: 一个闪亮的物体引起了她的注意。

examples.en: The object of the game is to score points.
examples.zh: 游戏的目标是得分。

examples.en: I object to your proposal.
examples.zh: 我反对你的提议。

paraphrase_en: ["A settled way of thinking or feeling about someone or something", "A position of the body that indicates a particular feeling or intention"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 对某人或某事的固定看法或感受", "n. 表示特定感觉或意图的身体姿势"]

examples.en: She has a positive attitude towards life.
examples.zh: 她对生活持积极态度。

examples.en: He stood with an aggressive attitude.
examples.zh: 他以攻击性的姿势站着。

paraphrase_en: ["Hard physical work", "Workers considered as a group", "To work hard or make great effort"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 体力劳动", "n. 工人阶级，尤指工会组织的工人", "v. 努力工作；辛勤劳作"]

examples.en: Construction requires a lot of labor.
examples.zh: 建筑需要大量体力劳动。

examples.en: Labor unions negotiate for better wages.
examples.zh: 工会为更高的工资进行谈判。

examples.en: She labored over the project for months.
examples.zh: 她为这个项目辛苦工作了几个月。

paraphrase_en: ["To mention or speak of something", "To direct someone to a person, place, or thing for information or help"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 提到或说起某事", "v. 指导某人向某人、某地或某物寻求信息或帮助"]

examples.zh: 他在演讲中参考了他的笔记。

examples.en: Please refer to the manual for instructions.
examples.zh: 请参阅手册获取说明。

paraphrase_en: ["An abstract idea or general notion", "A plan or intention, especially in art or design"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 抽象概念或一般观念", "n. （尤指艺术或设计中的）构思或意图"]

examples.en: The concept of time is difficult to grasp.
examples.zh: 时间的概念很难理解。

examples.en: The artist presented a new concept for the exhibition.
examples.zh: 艺术家为展览提出了一个新概念。

paraphrase_en: ["A person or organization that uses professional services", "(in computing) a computer that accesses a central server for data or resources"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 使用专业服务的个人或组织", "n. （计算机）向中央服务器请求数据或资源的计算机"]

examples.en: The lawyer met with her client to discuss the case.
examples.zh: 律师与她的客户会面讨论案件。

examples.en: The client software connects to the main database.
examples.zh: 客户端软件连接到主数据库。

paraphrase_en: ["Having great power, strength, or influence"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 强大的"]

examples.en: The powerful engine roared to life.
examples.zh: 强大的发动机轰鸣着启动了。

paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 完美的", "v. 使完美"]

examples.en: She is a perfect example of kindness.
examples.zh: 她是善良的完美榜样。

examples.en: He practiced to perfect his technique.
examples.zh: 他练习以完善技巧。

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 数字九", "adj. 九的"]

examples.en: Nine out of ten people agreed.
examples.zh: 十个人中有九个同意。

examples.en: The ninth chapter is on page nine.
examples.zh: 第九章在第九页。

paraphrase_en: ["For that reason; consequently"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 因此"]

examples.en: It was raining; therefore, the match was postponed.
examples.zh: 下雨了；因此比赛被推迟了。

paraphrase_en: ["To organize and carry out", "The way a person behaves"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 进行或指挥", "n. 行为或举止"]

examples.en: She conducted the meeting efficiently.
examples.zh: 她高效地主持了会议。

examples.en: His conduct was exemplary.
examples.zh: 他的行为堪称典范。

paraphrase_en: ["To make known publicly or officially"]

examples.en: The mayor will announce the new policy today.
examples.zh: 市长今天将宣布新政策。

paraphrase_en: ["A talk between two or more people"]

examples.en: They had a friendly conversation over coffee.
examples.zh: 他们边喝咖啡边友好地交谈。

paraphrase_en: ["To inspect or scrutinize carefully", "To test knowledge or ability"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 检查", "v. 考试"]

examples.en: The mechanic examined the car engine.
examples.zh: 机械师检查了汽车发动机。

examples.en: Students will be examined on their understanding of the text.
examples.zh: 学生们将被考察对课文的理解。

paraphrase_en: ["To come into physical contact with something", "The act or sensation of touching"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 触摸", "n. 触觉或接触"]

examples.en: Please don't touch the artwork.
examples.zh: 请不要触摸艺术品。

examples.en: The paint was still wet to the touch.
examples.zh: 油漆摸起来还是湿的。

examples.zh: 请把盐递给我。

examples.en: She always tries to please her parents.
examples.zh: 她总是试图取悦父母。

paraphrase_en: ["To be present at or go to an event.", "To deal with or take care of a task or matter."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 出席；参加", "v. 处理；照料"]

examples.en: She will attend the conference next week.
examples.zh: 她下周将出席这次会议。

examples.en: Please attend to this issue immediately.
examples.zh: 请立即处理这个问题。

paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 完全地；彻底地"]

examples.en: I completely forgot about the meeting.
examples.zh: 我完全忘记了会议。

examples.zh: 投票是一致同意的。

paraphrase_zh: ["n. 多样性；变化", "n. 种类；多种"]

examples.en: There is a variety of choices available.

examples.zh: 我可以请你喝一杯吗？

paraphrase_en: ["The star that gives light and heat to the earth", "The light or warmth from the sun"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 太阳", "n. 阳光，日光"]

examples.en: The sun rises every morning in the east.
examples.zh: 太阳每天早上从东方升起。

examples.en: Let's go outside and enjoy the sun.
examples.zh: 我们出去享受阳光吧。

paraphrase_en: ["The forward part or surface of something", "A leading or foremost position"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 前面，正面", "n. 前沿，领先地位"]

examples.en: The front of the building has a large entrance.
examples.zh: 大楼的正面有一个大入口。

examples.en: She always sits at the front of the class.
examples.zh: 她总是坐在班级的前面。

paraphrase_en: ["The length of the space between two points", "A point or area that is far away"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 距离", "n. 远处"]

examples.en: The distance between the two cities is about 300 kilometers.
examples.zh: 两个城市之间的距离大约是300公里。

examples.en: We watched the birds fly into the distance.
examples.zh: 我们看着鸟儿飞向远处。

paraphrase_en: ["The hard fibrous material that forms the main substance of the trunk and branches of a tree", "An area of land covered with trees, smaller than a forest"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 木材；木头", "n. 树林；小森林"]

examples.en: They used wood from the old barn to build a new fence.
examples.zh: 他们用旧谷仓的木材建造了新的栅栏。

examples.en: We took a leisurely walk through the woods near our house.
examples.zh: 我们在房子附近的树林里悠闲地散步。

paraphrase_en: ["A part of an object designed for holding, gripping, or carrying it", "To manage, deal with, or cope with something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 把手；柄", "v. 处理；操作"]

examples.en: The door handle was loose and needed to be fixed.
examples.zh: 门把手松了，需要修理。

examples.en: He handled the crisis calmly and efficiently.
examples.zh: 他冷静而高效地处理了危机。

paraphrase_en: ["A large motor vehicle designed to transport goods or heavy cargo"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 卡车；货车"]

examples.en: The truck delivered fresh produce to the supermarket early in the morning.
examples.zh: 卡车一大早就把新鲜农产品送到了超市。

paraphrase_en: ["To come or go back to a place or person", "The act of coming back to a place or situation"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 返回；回来", "n. 返回；归还"]

examples.en: She returned the book to the library after reading it.
examples.zh: 她读完后把书归还给了图书馆。

examples.en: His return to the team was celebrated with a party.
examples.zh: 他回归团队后举办了一个派对来庆祝。

paraphrase_en: ["A large natural elevation of the earth's surface rising abruptly from the surrounding level"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 山；山脉"]

examples.en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
examples.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界上最高的山。

paraphrase_en: ["A comprehensive study or poll to collect information or opinions", "To examine or investigate something thoroughly"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 调查；测量", "v. 调查；勘测"]

examples.en: The company conducted a survey to understand customer satisfaction.
examples.zh: 公司进行了一项调查以了解客户满意度。

examples.en: Experts surveyed the earthquake damage to plan reconstruction.
examples.zh: 专家们勘测了地震破坏情况以规划重建。

paraphrase_en: ["Generally assumed or believed to be true or intended to happen"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 应该的；预期的"]

examples.en: You're supposed to wear a helmet when riding a bike for safety.
examples.zh: 为了安全，骑自行车时你应该戴头盔。

paraphrase_en: ["A custom or belief that is passed down from one generation to the next"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 传统；惯例"]

examples.en: It's a tradition in many cultures to celebrate the New Year with fireworks.
examples.zh: 在许多文化中，用烟花庆祝新年是一个传统。

paraphrase_en: ["The coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 冬季；冬天"]

examples.en: Winter in Canada can be very harsh with heavy snowfall.
examples.zh: 加拿大的冬天可能非常严酷，伴有大雪。

paraphrase_en: ["A small community or group of houses in a rural area"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 村庄；乡村"]

examples.en: The old church is the heart of the village.
examples.zh: 这座老教堂是村庄的中心。

paraphrase_en: ["Relating to the former Soviet Union or its government.", "A citizen of the former Soviet Union; a governing council in the former Soviet system."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 苏联的", "n. 苏联人；苏维埃"]

examples.en: The Soviet era ended in 1991.
examples.zh: 苏联时代于1991年结束。

examples.en: He was a Soviet citizen before the dissolution.
examples.zh: 在解体前，他是苏联公民。

paraphrase_en: ["To decline or reject.", "Waste matter; rubbish."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 拒绝", "n. 垃圾，废物"]

examples.en: She refused the offer politely.
examples.zh: 她礼貌地拒绝了提议。

examples.en: The refuse was left on the curb for collection.
examples.zh: 垃圾被放在路边等待收集。

paraphrase_en: ["The activities associated with selling goods or services.", "The amount of goods sold in a given period."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 销售，推销", "n. 销售额，销量"]

examples.en: She works in the sales department.
examples.zh: 她在销售部门工作。

examples.en: Sales have increased by 10% this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度销售额增长了10%。

paraphrase_en: ["To move by revolving or turning over.", "A small loaf of bread.", "A list or register, as in a roll call."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 滚动，翻滚", "n. 面包卷，卷状物", "n. 名单，名册"]

examples.en: The ball rolled down the hill.
examples.zh: 球滚下了山坡。

examples.en: She had a bread roll with her soup.
examples.zh: 她喝汤时吃了一个面包卷。

examples.en: The teacher called the roll at the beginning of class.
examples.zh: 老师在上课开始时点了名。

paraphrase_en: ["The imparting or exchanging of information or news.", "Means of sending or receiving information, such as letters or phones."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 沟通，交流", "n. 通信，通讯"]

examples.en: Effective communication is key to a good relationship.
examples.zh: 有效沟通是良好关系的关键。

examples.en: Modern communication technologies have made the world smaller.
examples.zh: 现代通信技术使世界变小了。

paraphrase_en: ["To move swiftly on foot.", "To operate or function, as in running a business.", "A spell of running; a journey or route."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 跑，奔跑", "v. 运行，经营", "n. 奔跑，行程"]

examples.en: She runs every morning to stay fit.
examples.zh: 她每天早上跑步以保持健康。

examples.en: He runs a small bakery downtown.
examples.zh: 他在市中心经营一家小面包店。

examples.en: We went for a run in the park.
examples.zh: 我们在公园里跑了一圈。

paraphrase_en: ["A flat panel on which images or data are displayed.", "To show a film or broadcast to an audience.", "To examine or test for a particular condition or quality."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 屏幕，银幕", "v. 放映，播放", "v. 筛查，检查"]

examples.en: The movie was played on a large screen in the theater.
examples.zh: 电影在剧院的大屏幕上播放。

examples.en: They screened the new film at the festival.
examples.zh: 他们在电影节上放映了新电影。

examples.en: Doctors screen patients for early signs of disease.
examples.zh: 医生筛查病人疾病的早期迹象。

paraphrase_en: ["To obtain or earn something, especially something desirable.", "To increase in weight, speed, or other measurable quantity.", "Something gained or acquired; a profit or advantage."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 获得，赢得", "v. 增加，增长", "n. 收益，利润"]

examples.en: He gained valuable experience from his internship.
examples.zh: 他从实习中获得了宝贵的经验。

examples.en: The car gained speed as it went downhill.
examples.zh: 汽车下坡时速度增加了。

examples.en: The company reported a significant gain in profits.
examples.zh: 公司报告利润大幅增长。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who resides in a place; a permanent inhabitant."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 居民，住户"]

examples.en: All residents are invited to the community meeting.
examples.zh: 所有居民都被邀请参加社区会议。

paraphrase_en: ["To put or keep out of sight; to conceal.", "The skin of an animal, especially when tanned for leather."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 隐藏，躲藏", "n. 兽皮，皮革"]

examples.en: She tried to hide her disappointment with a smile.
examples.zh: 她试图用微笑来隐藏她的失望。

examples.en: The cow's hide was used to make leather goods.
examples.zh: 牛皮被用来制作皮革制品。

paraphrase_en: ["A dense, soft, yellow metal used especially for jewelry and decoration", "Having the color of gold"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n: 黄金；金", "adj: 金色的；黄金的"]

examples.en: Gold has been valued as a form of currency for centuries.
examples.zh: 黄金作为货币形式已有几个世纪的历史。

examples.en: The sunset cast a gold light over the landscape.
examples.zh: 夕阳在风景上投下金色的光芒。

paraphrase_en: ["An organization of people with a common interest or purpose", "A heavy stick used as a weapon or in sports"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n: 俱乐部；社团", "n: 棍棒；球棒"]

examples.en: She organized a local club for amateur photographers.
examples.zh: 她组织了一个业余摄影师的本地俱乐部。

examples.en: In historical warfare, a club was a common weapon.
examples.zh: 在历史战争中，棍棒是一种常见的武器。

paraphrase_en: ["The time that is to come", "At a later time; relating to the future"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n: 未来；将来", "adj: 未来的；将来的"]

examples.en: Investing in education shapes the future of our society.
examples.zh: 投资教育塑造我们社会的未来。

examples.en: Future generations will inherit the consequences of our actions.
examples.zh: 后代将继承我们行为的后果。

paraphrase_en: ["An area of land and its buildings used for growing crops and rearing animals", "To use land for growing crops and rearing animals"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n: 农场；农庄", "v: 务农；经营农场"]

examples.en: The family has operated the farm for over a century.
examples.zh: 这个家族经营这个农场已超过一个世纪。

examples.en: They decided to farm organically to promote sustainability.
examples.zh: 他们决定进行有机耕作以促进可持续发展。

paraphrase_en: ["The ability or capacity to develop or happen in the future", "Having or showing the capacity to become or develop into something in the future"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n: 潜力；可能性", "adj: 潜在的；可能的"]

examples.en: This new technology has the potential to revolutionize healthcare.
examples.zh: 这项新技术有潜力彻底改变医疗保健。

examples.en: Identifying potential risks early can prevent future problems.
examples.zh: 及早识别潜在风险可以预防未来问题。

paraphrase_en: ["To become or make greater in size, amount, or degree", "A rise in the amount, size, or degree"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v: 增加；增长", "n: 增加；增长"]

examples.en: The company aims to increase its market share this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年的目标是增加市场份额。

examples.en: There has been a steady increase in global temperatures.
examples.zh: 全球气温一直在稳定上升。

paraphrase_en: ["The point or part that is equidistant from the extremities", "At an equal distance from the ends or sides"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n: 中间；中央", "adj: 中间的；中部的"]

examples.en: The middle of the road was blocked by construction.
examples.zh: 道路中间被施工阻塞了。

examples.en: He chose a middle seat to avoid window glare.
examples.zh: 他选了一个中间座位以避免窗户眩光。

paraphrase_en: ["Of or relating to Europe or its inhabitants", "A native or inhabitant of Europe"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj: 欧洲的；欧洲人的", "n: 欧洲人"]

examples.en: European history is rich with diverse cultural influences.
examples.zh: 欧洲历史充满了多元的文化影响。

examples.en: Many Europeans celebrate Christmas with unique traditions.
examples.zh: 许多欧洲人以独特的传统庆祝圣诞节。

paraphrase_en: ["The state or fact of being present in a place", "A person or thing that exists or is present in a place"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n: 在场；存在", "n: 在场的人或物"]

examples.en: Her presence at the conference added credibility to the discussion.
examples.zh: 她出席会议为讨论增添了可信度。

examples.en: The artist's presence in the gallery was felt through her powerful paintings.
examples.zh: 艺术家通过其有力的画作在画廊中展现了存在感。

paraphrase_en: ["Not influenced or controlled by others; free to act or think independently", "A person who does not belong to a particular party or group"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj: 独立的；自主的", "n: 独立派人士；独立实体"]

examples.en: She is an independent thinker who challenges traditional ideas.
examples.zh: 她是一个挑战传统观念的独立思考者。

examples.en: As an independent in the election, he refused campaign funding from major parties.
examples.zh: 作为选举中的独立候选人，他拒绝接受主要政党的竞选资金。

paraphrase_en: ["An area of a country or city, especially one with particular characteristics or designated for a particular purpose."]

examples.en: The financial district is full of skyscrapers.
examples.zh: 金融区到处都是摩天大楼。

paraphrase_en: ["The external form, contours, or outline of someone or something.", "To give a particular form or shape to something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 形状，外形。", "v. 塑造，形成。"]

examples.en: The table is in the shape of an oval.
examples.zh: 这张桌子是椭圆形的。

examples.en: Public opinion can shape government policy.
examples.zh: 舆论可以塑造政府政策。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who reads.", "A book containing selected passages for reading, especially for learning a language.", "A device for reading data, such as a barcode reader."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 读者。", "n. 读本，教材。", "n. 阅读器，读取器。"]

examples.en: She is an avid reader of mystery novels.
examples.zh: 她是悬疑小说的热心读者。

examples.en: The English reader includes various short stories.
examples.zh: 这本英语读本包含各种短篇故事。

examples.en: Use the card reader to scan your ID.
examples.zh: 使用读卡器扫描您的身份证。

paraphrase_en: ["A title used before a woman's name, especially when her marital status is unknown or irrelevant."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 女士（用于女子姓名前，不指明婚否）。"]

examples.en: Ms. Johnson will be leading the meeting today.
examples.zh: 约翰逊女士今天将主持会议。

paraphrase_en: ["A written legal agreement between two or more parties.", "To enter into a formal and legally binding agreement.", "To become reduced in size, number, or extent."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 合同，契约。", "v. 订立合同，承包。", "v. 收缩，缩小。"]

examples.en: They signed a contract for the new project.
examples.zh: 他们为这个新项目签订了合同。

examples.en: The company contracted with a local firm for construction.
examples.zh: 公司与当地一家公司签订了建设合同。

examples.en: The metal contracts when it cools down.
examples.zh: 金属冷却时会收缩。

paraphrase_en: ["A large number of people gathered together in a disorderly way.", "To fill (a space) almost to overflowing."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 人群，群众。", "v. 拥挤，塞满。"]

examples.en: A crowd gathered in the town square for the festival.
examples.zh: 一群人聚集在镇广场上参加节日活动。

examples.en: Fans crowded the stadium to watch the final match.
examples.zh: 粉丝们挤满了体育场观看决赛。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who believes in Jesus Christ and follows his teachings.", "Relating to or professing Christianity or its teachings."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 基督徒。", "adj. 基督教的，信奉基督教的。"]

examples.en: He is a devout Christian who attends church every Sunday.
examples.zh: 他是一个虔诚的基督徒，每周日都去教堂。

examples.en: Christian values are important in their family.
examples.zh: 基督教价值观在他们家庭中很重要。

paraphrase_en: ["To convey (a thought or feeling) in words or by gestures and conduct.", "Operating at high speed; fast.", "A fast train that stops at few intermediate stations."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 表达，表示。", "adj. 快速的，明确的。", "n. 快车，快递服务。"]

examples.en: She expressed her gratitude with a smile.
examples.zh: 她用微笑表达了感激之情。

examples.en: The express lane was for customers with fewer items.
examples.zh: 快速通道是为购买物品较少的顾客设置的。

examples.en: We took the express to get there quickly.
examples.zh: 我们乘坐快车以快速到达那里。

paraphrase_en: ["A suite of rooms forming one residence, typically in a building containing a number of these."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 公寓，一套房间。"]

examples.en: They rented a two-bedroom apartment downtown.
examples.zh: 他们在市中心租了一套两居室的公寓。

paraphrase_en: ["Ready and eager to do something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 愿意的，乐意的。"]

examples.en: She is willing to help with the project.
examples.zh: 她愿意帮助这个项目。

paraphrase_en: ["The quality or state of being physically strong.", "A good or beneficial quality or attribute."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(n.) 力量，力气", "(n.) 优点，长处"]

examples.en: He has the strength to lift heavy weights.
examples.zh: 他有力气举起重物。

examples.en: Patience is one of her strengths.
examples.zh: 耐心是她的优点之一。

paraphrase_en: ["Existing or occurring before in time or order."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(adj.) 先前的，以前的"]

examples.en: I saw her on the previous day.
examples.zh: 我在前一天见过她。

paraphrase_en: ["A group of musicians who play together.", "A strip or loop of material used for tying or fastening."]

examples.en: The band played at the concert last night.
examples.zh: 乐队昨晚在音乐会上演出。

examples.en: She put a rubber band around the papers.
examples.zh: 她用橡皮筋把文件捆起来。

paraphrase_en: ["In a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(adv.) 显然地，明显地"]

examples.en: Obviously, he was not happy with the decision.
examples.zh: 显然，他对这个决定不满意。

paraphrase_en: ["A large four-legged animal used for riding, carrying loads, or in sport."]

examples.en: The horse galloped across the field.
examples.zh: 马在田野上奔驰。

paraphrase_en: ["Showing curiosity or concern about something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(adj.) 感兴趣的"]

examples.en: She is very interested in learning Chinese.
examples.zh: 她对学习中文非常感兴趣。

paraphrase_en: ["An object, person, or place that is aimed at or attacked.", "To aim or direct something at a specific target."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(n.) 目标，靶子", "(v.) 以…为目标"]

examples.en: The arrow hit the center of the target.
examples.zh: 箭射中了靶心。

examples.en: The campaign targeted young voters.
examples.zh: 这次竞选活动以年轻选民为目标。

paraphrase_en: ["A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes."]

examples.en: He was sent to prison for five years.
examples.zh: 他被送进监狱五年。

paraphrase_en: ["To travel on or in a vehicle, animal, or device.", "A journey on a vehicle or animal."]

examples.en: She likes to ride her bicycle to work.
examples.zh: 她喜欢骑自行车上班。

examples.en: The bus ride was very long.
examples.zh: 这次公交车旅程很长。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who protects or watches over something.", "To watch over or protect something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["(n.) 守卫，警卫", "(v.) 守卫，保卫"]

examples.en: The security guard stopped us at the door.
examples.zh: 保安在门口拦住了我们。

examples.en: He guarded the treasure carefully.
examples.zh: 他小心地守卫着财宝。

paraphrase_en: ["Conditions or stipulations", "Periods of time", "Words or phrases in a context"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 条件或规定", "n. 时间段", "n. 特定语境中的词语或短语"]

examples.en: They agreed on the terms of the contract.
examples.zh: 他们就合同条款达成了一致。

examples.en: He was elected for a term of four years.
examples.zh: 他被选为任期四年。

examples.en: Learn the technical terms used in the field.
examples.zh: 学习该领域使用的术语。

paraphrase_en: ["A strong request", "To ask for something forcefully", "The desire for a product or service"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 强烈的要求", "v. 强烈或紧急地要求某物", "n. 消费者对产品或服务的需求"]

examples.en: There is a high demand for skilled workers.
examples.zh: 对熟练工人有很高的需求。

examples.en: The workers demanded higher wages.
examples.zh: 工人们要求更高的工资。

examples.en: The demand for electric vehicles is increasing.
examples.zh: 对电动汽车的需求在增加。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who reports news for media"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 为媒体报告新闻的人"]

examples.en: The reporter covered the story from the scene.
examples.zh: 记者在现场报道了这个故事。

paraphrase_en: ["To take something to a person or place", "To give a speech or performance", "To do what is promised"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 将某物带到某人或某地", "v. 发表演讲或表演", "v. 履行承诺"]

examples.en: The postman delivers mail every morning.
examples.zh: 邮递员每天早上送信。

examples.en: She delivered a powerful speech at the conference.
examples.zh: 她在会议上发表了强有力的演讲。

examples.en: The company failed to deliver on its promises.
examples.zh: 公司未能履行其承诺。

paraphrase_en: ["Written or printed words", "A text message", "To send a text message"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 书写的或印刷的文字", "n. 短信", "v. 发送短信"]

examples.en: The text of the speech was carefully prepared.
examples.zh: 演讲的文本是精心准备的。

examples.en: I received a text from my friend.
examples.zh: 我收到了朋友的一条短信。

examples.en: Please text me the address.
examples.zh: 请用短信把地址发给我。

paraphrase_en: ["To give a portion of something to others or have in common", "A portion of something divided among people"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 将某物的一部分给予他人或与他人共有", "n. 在人们之间分配的一部分"]

examples.en: Let's share the pizza.
examples.zh: 我们分享这个披萨吧。
