paraphrase_zh: ["n. 大厅；走廊。", "n. 礼堂；会堂。"]

examples.en: The school hall was decorated with balloons and streamers for the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 学校的大厅用气球和彩带装饰，为毕业典礼做准备。

examples.en: The concert will be held in the town hall due to its spacious seating.
examples.zh: 由于市政厅座位宽敞，音乐会将在那里举行。

paraphrase_en: ["A firm belief in the honesty and reliability of someone or something.", "To have confidence in the reliability or truth of someone or something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 信任；信赖。", "v. 信任；相信。"]

examples.en: Their long-term relationship is built on mutual trust and respect.
examples.zh: 他们长期的关系建立在相互信任和尊重之上。

examples.en: I trust her to handle the situation professionally and make the right decision.
examples.zh: 我相信她会专业地处理这种情况并做出正确的决定。

paraphrase_en: ["A vast body of salt water that covers most of the earth's surface."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 海洋；大洋。"]

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean in the world.
examples.zh: 太平洋是世界上最大、最深的海洋。

paraphrase_en: ["The number of points, goals, or runs achieved in a game or competition.", "A group of twenty things.", "To win points or achieve a success in a game or test."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 分数；比分。", "n. 二十个。", "v. 得分；获胜。"]

examples.en: The final score of the soccer match was 3-2 in favor of the home team.
examples.zh: 足球比赛的最终比分是3比2，主队获胜。

examples.en: A score of people gathered in the hall for the lecture.
examples.zh: 大约二十人聚集在大厅里听讲座。

examples.en: He scored the winning goal in the last minute of the game.
examples.zh: 他在比赛的最后一分钟打进了制胜一球。

paraphrase_en: ["A line of people or things side by side.", "A noisy argument or quarrel.", "To move a boat through water using oars."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 一排；一行。", "n. 争吵；吵闹。", "v. 划船。"]

examples.en: We sat in the front row of the theater for the best view.
examples.zh: 我们坐在剧院的前排，以便获得最佳视野。

examples.en: They had a loud row about the budget allocation for the project.
examples.zh: 他们就项目的预算分配大吵了一架。

examples.en: She loves to row on the lake every morning for exercise.
examples.zh: 她喜欢每天早晨在湖上划船锻炼。

paraphrase_en: ["A person or thing that makes or manufactures something.", "A person who oversees the creation of a film, play, or other artistic production."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 生产者；制造商。", "n. 制片人；监制。"]

examples.en: The farm is a major producer of organic vegetables in the region.
examples.zh: 这家农场是该地区有机蔬菜的主要生产者。

examples.en: The producer of the documentary won several awards at the film festival.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片的制片人在电影节上赢得了多个奖项。

paraphrase_en: ["To have enough money or resources to do or buy something.", "To provide or supply something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 负担得起；买得起。", "v. 提供；给予。"]

examples.en: I can't afford a new car right now due to my budget.
examples.zh: 由于预算有限，我现在买不起新车。

examples.en: The job affords great opportunities for travel and learning.
examples.zh: 这份工作提供了很多旅行和学习的机会。

paraphrase_en: ["During the intervening time; at the same time.", "The intervening time or period."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 在此期间；与此同时。", "n. 间隔时间；与此同时。"]

examples.en: She finished her work early. Meanwhile, he was still at the office.
examples.zh: 她早早完成了工作。与此同时，他还在办公室。

examples.en: In the meanwhile, I'll prepare the documents for the meeting.
examples.zh: 在此期间，我会准备会议文件。

paraphrase_en: ["A government, especially an authoritarian one", "A system or planned way of doing things"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 政权；政体", "n. 体制；制度"]

examples.en: The new regime implemented strict economic reforms.
examples.zh: 新政权实施了严格的经济改革。

examples.en: She follows a strict exercise regime to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 她遵循严格的锻炼制度以保持健康。

paraphrase_en: ["The action of separating something into parts", "A major unit of an organization or group"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 分开；分割", "n. 部门；师"]

examples.en: The division of the company into smaller units improved management.
examples.zh: 将公司分成较小的单位改善了管理。

examples.en: He was promoted to head the sales division.
examples.zh: 他被提升为销售部的主管。

paraphrase_en: ["To establish the truth or correctness of something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 确认；证实"]

examples.en: Please confirm your reservation by calling the hotel.
examples.zh: 请打电话给酒店确认您的预订。

paraphrase_en: ["To repair or mend something", "A solution to a problem or a quick remedy"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 修理；固定", "n. 解决办法；快速补救措施"]

examples.en: Can you fix the leaky faucet in the kitchen?
examples.zh: 你能修理厨房里漏水的水龙头吗？

examples.en: We need a temporary fix until we can find a permanent solution.
examples.zh: 在找到永久解决方案之前，我们需要一个临时补救措施。

paraphrase_en: ["A formal request to a higher authority", "The quality of being attractive or interesting"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 上诉；呼吁", "n. 吸引力；魅力"]

examples.en: The lawyer prepared an appeal to the Supreme Court.
examples.zh: 律师准备向最高法院提出上诉。

examples.en: This product has broad appeal among young consumers.
examples.zh: 这款产品在年轻消费者中具有广泛的吸引力。

paraphrase_en: ["A polished surface that reflects a clear image", "To reflect or represent something accurately"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 镜子", "v. 反映；映照"]

examples.en: She checked her appearance in the mirror before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前，她在镜子里检查了自己的外表。

examples.en: The calm lake mirrored the surrounding mountains perfectly.
examples.zh: 平静的湖面完美地映照出周围的群山。

paraphrase_en: ["One of the hard, bony enamel-covered structures in the jaws used for biting and chewing"]

examples.en: I have a cavity in one of my molars and need to see a dentist.
examples.zh: 我有一颗臼齿有蛀牙，需要看牙医。

paraphrase_en: ["Intelligent; quick-witted", "Stylish; fashionable"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 聪明的；机智的", "adj. 时髦的；漂亮的"]

examples.en: She is a smart student who always excels in exams.
examples.zh: 她是一个聪明的学生，总是在考试中表现出色。

examples.en: He looked very smart in his new suit for the interview.
examples.zh: 他面试时穿着新西装，看起来很时髦。

paraphrase_en: ["The measurement or extent of something from end to end", "A period of time or duration"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 长度", "n. 时间长度；期间"]

examples.en: The length of the bridge is over two kilometers.
examples.zh: 这座桥的长度超过两公里。

examples.en: He stayed for the entire length of the performance.
examples.zh: 他在整个演出期间一直待着。

paraphrase_en: ["Completely; wholly"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 完全地；彻底地"]

examples.en: I entirely agree with your decision to move forward.
examples.zh: 我完全同意你继续推进的决定。

paraphrase_en: ["To depend on or trust in"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 依赖；信赖"]

examples.en: You can rely on me for help.
examples.zh: 你可以依赖我的帮助。

paraphrase_en: ["A subject of conversation or study"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 话题；主题"]

examples.en: The topic of the meeting was budget cuts.
examples.zh: 会议的话题是预算削减。

paraphrase_en: ["To express dissatisfaction or annoyance"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 抱怨；投诉"]

examples.en: Customers often complain about slow service.
examples.zh: 顾客经常抱怨服务慢。

paraphrase_en: ["A topic or problem of concern", "To distribute or put forth"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 问题；议题", "v. 发行；发布"]

examples.en: Climate change is a global issue.
examples.zh: 气候变化是一个全球性问题。

examples.en: The company will issue new shares.
examples.zh: 公司将发行新股。

paraphrase_en: ["Liable to change or vary", "A factor or quantity that can change"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 可变的；易变的", "n. 变量；可变因素"]

examples.en: The weather is very variable here.
examples.zh: 这里的天气非常多变。

examples.en: In the equation, x is a variable.
examples.zh: 在方程中，x是一个变量。

paraphrase_en: ["The rear part of something", "Toward the rear or in return", "To support or endorse"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 背部；后面", "adv. 向后；回", "v. 支持；背书"]

examples.en: He has a pain in his back.
examples.zh: 他背部疼痛。

examples.en: Please step back.
examples.zh: 请后退一步。

examples.en: I back your decision.
examples.zh: 我支持你的决定。

paraphrase_en: ["The extent or variety of something", "To vary or extend within limits"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 范围；系列", "v. 变动；延伸"]

examples.en: The price range is from $10 to $100.
examples.zh: 价格范围从10美元到100美元。

examples.en: Temperatures range from 20 to 30 degrees.
examples.zh: 温度在20到30度之间变动。

paraphrase_en: ["A device for voice communication over distance", "To contact someone by phone"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 电话", "v. 打电话给"]

examples.en: I answered the telephone quickly.
examples.zh: 我迅速接了电话。

examples.en: I will telephone you tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我明天会打电话给你。

paraphrase_en: ["The ability to perceive through the senses", "A way of understanding or interpreting something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 感知；知觉", "n. 看法；理解"]

examples.en: Visual perception is crucial for driving.
examples.zh: 视觉感知对驾驶至关重要。

examples.en: Public perception of the issue has changed.
examples.zh: 公众对这个问题的看法已经改变。

paraphrase_en: ["To cause to come closer or adhere", "To draw interest or attention"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 吸引；引起", "v. 吸引；诱使"]

examples.en: The magnet can attract metal objects.
examples.zh: 磁铁能吸引金属物体。

examples.en: Her beauty attracted many admirers.
examples.zh: 她的美貌吸引了许多仰慕者。

paraphrase_en: ["The feeling of certainty about one's abilities or trust in someone.", "A private conversation or secret.", "Trust or faith in a person or thing."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 信心，自信", "n. 秘密，知心话", "n. 信任，信赖"]

examples.en: She spoke with confidence during the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在演讲时自信地发言。

examples.en: He shared a confidence with his close friend.
examples.zh: 他与密友分享了一个秘密。

examples.en: The public has lost confidence in the government.
examples.zh: 公众对政府失去了信任。

paraphrase_en: ["A room used for sleeping in.", "Relating to a residential area primarily for sleeping, with residents commuting elsewhere for work."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 卧室", "adj. 睡城的，通勤住宅区的"]

examples.en: The bedroom is upstairs, next to the bathroom.
examples.zh: 卧室在楼上，紧挨着浴室。

examples.en: They moved to a bedroom community to afford a larger house.
examples.zh: 他们搬到了一个睡城以买得起更大的房子。

paraphrase_en: ["Something that is kept or meant to be kept unknown.", "Not known or seen by others; hidden.", "A method or plan unknown to others."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 秘密，机密", "adj. 秘密的，隐蔽的", "n. 秘诀，奥秘"]

examples.en: She promised to keep his secret safe.
examples.zh: 她承诺保守他的秘密。

examples.en: They held a secret meeting in the basement.
examples.zh: 他们在地下室举行了一次秘密会议。

examples.en: The secret to success is hard work and dedication.
examples.zh: 成功的秘诀是努力工作和奉献。

paraphrase_en: ["A sum of money that is owed or due.", "A state of owing something, especially gratitude.", "Financial obligations or liabilities."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 债务，欠款", "n. 人情债，恩情", "n. 负债"]

examples.en: He struggled to pay off his student debt.
examples.zh: 他努力偿还学生债务。

examples.en: I owe you a debt of gratitude for your help.
examples.zh: 感谢你的帮助，我欠你一个人情。

examples.en: The country's national debt has increased significantly.
examples.zh: 该国的国债大幅增加。

paraphrase_en: ["Not occurring very often; uncommon.", "Cooked lightly; not thoroughly done.", "Of high quality or unusual value."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 罕见的，稀有的", "adj. 半熟的，三分熟的（牛排等）", "adj. 珍贵的，杰出的"]

examples.en: It is rare to see snow in this region.
examples.zh: 在这个地区很少看到雪。

examples.en: He ordered his steak rare.
examples.zh: 他点了三分熟的牛排。

examples.en: This is a rare opportunity for young artists.
examples.zh: 这对年轻艺术家来说是一个难得的机会。

paraphrase_en: ["Belonging to or associated with a male person or animal previously mentioned.", "Used to refer to a male person or animal as a possessive."]
paraphrase_zh: ["det. 他的", "pron. 他的（东西）"]

examples.en: This is his book; he left it on the table.
examples.zh: 这是他的书；他把它放在桌子上了。

examples.en: The choice is his to make.
examples.zh: 选择权在他。

paraphrase_en: ["A large container for storing liquid or gas.", "A heavy armored fighting vehicle.", "A container for keeping fish or other aquatic animals."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 罐，槽，箱", "n. 坦克", "n. 鱼缸，水箱"]

examples.en: He filled the water tank for the garden irrigation.
examples.zh: 他为花园灌溉装满了水箱。

examples.en: The military deployed tanks along the border.
examples.zh: 军方在边境部署了坦克。

examples.en: The fish tank needs to be cleaned regularly.
examples.zh: 鱼缸需要定期清洁。

paraphrase_en: ["A person trained to care for the sick or injured.", "To care for the sick or injured.", "To breastfeed an infant."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 护士", "v. 护理，照顾", "v. 哺乳，喂养"]

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient's vital signs.
examples.zh: 护士检查了病人的生命体征。

examples.en: She decided to nurse her mother back to health.
examples.zh: 她决定护理母亲恢复健康。

examples.en: The mother was nursing her baby in the nursery.
examples.zh: 母亲在育婴室喂养婴儿。

paraphrase_en: ["The extent to which something is covered or included.", "Reporting by media on a particular topic.", "Insurance protection against loss or damage."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 覆盖范围，覆盖程度", "n. 报道，新闻报道", "n. 保险范围，保险项目"]

examples.en: The network provides coverage of 95% of the country.
examples.zh: 该网络覆盖了全国95%的地区。

examples.en: The media's coverage of the event was extensive.
examples.zh: 媒体对该事件的报道非常广泛。

examples.en: Your insurance policy includes coverage for natural disasters.
examples.zh: 您的保险政策包括自然灾害的保险范围。

paraphrase_en: ["The action of disagreeing with or resisting something.", "A group of people opposing or competing against another.", "The political party or group not in power."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 反对，反抗", "n. 对手，反对派", "n. 在野党，反对党"]

examples.en: The proposal faced strong opposition from environmental groups.
examples.zh: 该提案遭到环保团体的强烈反对。

examples.en: The opposition criticized the government's handling of the crisis.
examples.zh: 反对派批评政府对危机的处理方式。

examples.en: The opposition party gained seats in the recent election.
examples.zh: 反对党在最近的选举中赢得了席位。

paraphrase_en: ["To or on one side, out of the way", "A remark made quietly, not intended for everyone to hear"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 在旁边；到旁边", "n. 旁白；低声说的话"]

examples.en: She stepped aside to let the busy crowd pass through.
examples.zh: 她走到一边让匆忙的人群通过。

examples.en: He made an aside to his friend during the boring lecture.
examples.zh: 在无聊的讲座期间，他向朋友低声说了句话。

paraphrase_en: ["In or to any place or location", "To any extent or degree, used for emphasis"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 任何地方；无论何处", "adv. 无论如何；在任何程度上"]

examples.en: You can sit anywhere you like in the empty theater.
examples.zh: 在空荡的剧院里，你喜欢坐哪儿就坐哪儿。

examples.en: This project isn't anywhere near completion.
examples.zh: 这个项目还远远没有完成。

paraphrase_en: ["A connection or tie between people, groups, or things", "A financial instrument representing debt issued to raise capital", "To connect or join securely, often with adhesive or strong emotion"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 纽带；联系", "n. 债券", "v. 粘合；结合"]

examples.en: The bond between mother and child is often unbreakable.
examples.zh: 母子之间的纽带通常是牢不可破的。

examples.en: He invested in government bonds for stable returns.
examples.zh: 他投资了政府债券以获得稳定回报。

examples.en: The special glue bonds the pieces together permanently.
examples.zh: 这种特殊胶水将碎片永久粘合在一起。

paraphrase_en: ["A folder or collection of related documents or data", "To submit or record something officially for processing", "A tool with a rough surface for shaping or smoothing materials"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 文件；档案", "v. 提交；存档", "n. 锉刀"]

examples.en: Please save the document in the correct file on your computer.
examples.zh: 请将文档保存在电脑中正确的文件中。

examples.en: He filed a complaint with the customer service department.
examples.zh: 他向客户服务部门提交了投诉。

examples.en: Use a file to smooth the sharp edge of the metal.
examples.zh: 用锉刀磨平金属的锋利边缘。

paraphrase_en: ["A feeling of happy satisfaction or enjoyment", "An event or activity from which one derives enjoyment"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 快乐；愉悦", "n. 乐事；乐趣"]

examples.en: It gives me great pleasure to help others in need.
examples.zh: 帮助有需要的人给我带来极大的快乐。

examples.en: Reading a good book is one of my simple pleasures.
examples.zh: 读一本好书是我简单的乐趣之一。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who has control, authority, or expertise", "To acquire complete knowledge or skill in something", "An original copy of a document, recording, or work"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 主人；大师", "v. 精通；掌握", "n. 母带；原版"]

examples.en: The dog obeyed its master's command without hesitation.
examples.zh: 狗毫不犹豫地服从主人的命令。

examples.en: She mastered three foreign languages through hard work.
examples.zh: 她通过努力精通了三门外语。

examples.en: The master tape was used for high-quality duplication.
examples.zh: 母带用于高质量复制。

paraphrase_en: ["A long and distinct period of history", "A system of chronology or dating"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 时代；纪元", "n. 年代；时期"]

examples.en: The Victorian era was known for its cultural achievements.
examples.zh: 维多利亚时代以其文化成就而闻名。

examples.en: We are living in the digital era of technology.
examples.zh: 我们生活在数字技术时代。

paraphrase_en: ["Something that is needed or demanded", "A condition that must be fulfilled or met"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 需求；必要条件", "n. 要求；规定"]

examples.en: Meeting the basic requirements is essential for survival.
examples.zh: 满足基本需求对生存至关重要。

examples.en: The job has specific requirements for relevant experience.
examples.zh: 这份工作对相关经验有特定要求。

paraphrase_en: ["To examine or verify something for accuracy", "A written order to a bank to pay a specified amount", "To restrain or stop something from progressing"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 检查；核对", "n. 支票", "v. 阻止；抑制"]

examples.en: Please check your answers before submitting the test.
examples.zh: 提交试卷前请检查答案。

examples.en: He wrote a check to pay the monthly rent.
examples.zh: 他开了一张支票付月租。

examples.en: The dam checks the flow of the river.
examples.zh: 大坝抑制了河水的流动。

paraphrase_en: ["To be in an upright position on your feet", "A structure or booth for selling or displaying items", "To tolerate or endure something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 站立", "n. 摊位；架子", "v. 忍受；容忍"]

examples.en: Please stand up when the teacher enters the room.
examples.zh: 老师进教室时请起立。

examples.en: I bought a hot dog from a food stand at the festival.
examples.zh: 我从节日的食品摊买了个热狗。

examples.en: I can't stand his rude behavior any longer.
examples.zh: 我再也受不了他粗鲁的行为。

paraphrase_en: ["Enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure.", "Enjoyable or amusing."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 乐趣，娱乐", "adj. 有趣的，好玩的"]

examples.en: We had a lot of fun at the party.
examples.zh: 我们在派对上玩得很开心。

examples.en: That was a fun activity.
examples.zh: 那是一项有趣的活动。

paraphrase_en: ["A strong belief that something will happen or be the case in the future.", "A belief that someone should achieve something."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 期望，预期", "n. 期待，指望"]

examples.en: There is an expectation that the economy will improve.
examples.zh: 人们预期经济会好转。

examples.en: She has high expectations for her children.

examples.zh: 许多公民反对新税收政策。

paraphrase_en: ["Living or occurring at the same time", "A person or thing living or existing at the same time as another"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 当代的；同时代的", "n. 同时代的人；当代事物"]

examples.en: Contemporary art often challenges traditional forms.
examples.zh: 当代艺术常常挑战传统形式。

examples.en: Shakespeare and his contemporaries shaped English literature.
examples.zh: 莎士比亚和他的同代人塑造了英国文学。

paraphrase_en: ["A way or course taken in getting from a starting point to a destination", "To send or direct along a specified course"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 路线；路程", "v. 按路线发送；定路线"]

examples.en: The fastest route to the airport is via the highway.
examples.zh: 去机场最快的路线是走高速公路。

examples.en: We need to route the delivery through the central hub.
examples.zh: 我们需要将配送路线定为中心枢纽。

paraphrase_en: ["Having or involving many parts, elements, or individuals.", "A number that contains another number an exact number of times."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 多个的；多重的。", "n. 倍数。"]

examples.en: She has multiple skills.
examples.zh: 她有多种技能。

examples.en: 12 is a multiple of 3.
examples.zh: 12是3的倍数。

paraphrase_en: ["Absolutely necessary; extremely important.", "Something that is basic or indispensable."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 必要的；必不可少的。", "n. 要素；必需品。"]

examples.en: Water is essential for life.
examples.zh: 水是生命所必需的。

examples.en: The essentials for camping include a tent and sleeping bag.
examples.zh: 露营的必需品包括帐篷和睡袋。

paraphrase_en: ["A sentence that asks for information.", "A matter or issue that is in doubt or needs discussion.", "To ask someone questions, especially in a formal way."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 问题。", "n. 疑问；议题。", "v. 询问；质问。"]

examples.en: She asked a question about the homework.
examples.zh: 她问了一个关于作业的问题。

examples.en: The question of funding is still unresolved.
examples.zh: 资金问题仍未解决。

examples.en: The police questioned the suspect for hours.
examples.zh: 警察审问了嫌疑人几个小时。

paraphrase_en: ["A group of sports teams that play against each other.", "An association of people or countries with a common interest.", "A unit of distance, approximately 3 miles or 4.8 kilometers."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 联盟；联赛。", "n. 同盟；协会。", "n. 里格（长度单位）。"]

examples.en: He plays in the national football league.
examples.zh: 他在国家足球联赛中踢球。

examples.en: The countries formed a league for mutual defense.
examples.zh: 这些国家组成了一个共同防御联盟。

examples.en: The journey was several leagues long.
examples.zh: 旅程有好几里格长。

paraphrase_en: ["Relating to or involving crime.", "A person who has committed a crime."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 犯罪的；刑事的。", "n. 罪犯。"]

examples.en: He was investigated for criminal activity.
examples.zh: 他因犯罪活动被调查。

examples.en: The criminal was arrested by the police.
examples.zh: 罪犯被警察逮捕了。

paraphrase_en: ["Making sure to avoid potential problems or dangers; cautious.", "Done with attention and precision."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 小心的；谨慎的。", "adj. 细致的；精心的。"]

examples.en: Be careful when crossing the street.
examples.zh: 过马路时要小心。

examples.en: She did a careful analysis of the data.
examples.zh: 她对数据进行了细致的分析。

paraphrase_en: ["The central or most important part of something.", "The hard central part of a fruit that contains the seeds.", "To remove the core from a fruit."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 核心；中心。", "n. 果心。", "v. 挖去果心。"]

examples.en: Trust is the core of any relationship.
examples.zh: 信任是任何关系的核心。

examples.en: The apple core was left on the table.
examples.zh: 苹果核留在桌上。

examples.en: She cored the apples before baking.
examples.zh: 她在烘焙前挖去了苹果的果心。

paraphrase_en: ["Situated above or higher in position.", "The part of a shoe or boot above the sole."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 上面的；上部的。", "n. 鞋面。"]

examples.en: The upper shelf is hard to reach.
examples.zh: 上面的架子很难够到。

examples.en: The shoe's upper is made of leather.
examples.zh: 鞋面是皮革做的。

paraphrase_en: ["To move or act with urgent haste.", "A sudden, rapid movement or action.", "A period of intense activity or demand."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 匆忙；急忙。", "n. 冲；奔。", "n. 高峰期；忙碌时期。"]

examples.en: Don't rush; take your time.
examples.zh: 别急；慢慢来。

examples.en: There was a rush for the exits.
examples.zh: 人们冲向出口。

examples.en: The morning rush hour traffic was heavy.
examples.zh: 早高峰交通很拥堵。

paraphrase_en: ["In a way that is required or needed; inevitably.", "Used to indicate that something is not always or definitely true."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 必然地；不可避免地。", "adv. 不一定；未必。"]

examples.en: The outcome is necessarily uncertain.
examples.zh: 结果必然是不确定的。

examples.en: He is not necessarily the best candidate.
examples.zh: 他不一定是最佳候选人。

paraphrase_en: ["In a way that is exact and clear; in particular."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 具体地，特别地。"]

examples.en: The rules were specifically designed for this situation.
examples.zh: 这些规则是专门为这种情况设计的。

paraphrase_en: ["In need of sleep or rest; weary."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 疲倦的，累的。"]

examples.en: I'm tired after a long day at work.
examples.zh: 工作一整天后，我感到很疲倦。

paraphrase_en: ["To move from a lower position to a higher one.", "To increase in amount, number, or value.", "An increase in amount, number, or value."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 上升，升起。", "v. 增加，上涨。", "n. 增长，上涨。"]

examples.en: The sun rises in the east every morning.
examples.zh: 太阳每天早晨从东方升起。

examples.en: Prices have risen significantly this year.
examples.zh: 今年价格大幅上涨。

examples.en: There has been a rise in global temperatures.
examples.zh: 全球气温有所上升。

paraphrase_en: ["To attach or fasten with string or similar cord.", "A strip of material worn around the collar, tied in a knot at the front.", "A bond or connection."]

examples.en: He tied the package with a sturdy rope.
examples.zh: 他用一根结实的绳子把包裹系好。

examples.en: He wore a blue tie to the formal meeting.
examples.zh: 他在正式会议上系了一条蓝色领带。

examples.en: Family ties are very important in our culture.
examples.zh: 在我们文化中，家庭纽带非常重要。

paraphrase_en: ["To give work to someone and pay them.", "To make use of."]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 雇佣。", "v. 使用，利用。"]

examples.en: The company employs over 500 people.
examples.zh: 这家公司雇佣了500多名员工。

examples.en: She employed various methods to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 她使用了多种方法来解决问题。

paraphrase_en: ["A day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.", "A vacation or period of time spent away from work or school."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 节日，假日。", "n. 假期，休假。"]

examples.en: Christmas is a public holiday in many countries.
examples.zh: 圣诞节在许多国家是公共假日。

examples.en: We went on holiday to Spain last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我们去西班牙度假了。

paraphrase_en: ["To move rhythmically to music.", "A social gathering for dancing.", "A sequence of rhythmic steps and movements."]

examples.en: They danced all night at the party.
examples.zh: 他们在派对上跳了一整夜舞。

examples.en: We're going to a dance this Saturday.
examples.zh: 我们这周六要去参加一个舞会。

examples.en: The ballet dance was beautifully choreographed.
examples.zh: 这段芭蕾舞的编排非常优美。

paraphrase_en: ["Of very great extent or quantity; immense."]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 广阔的，巨大的。"]

examples.en: The vast desert stretched for miles without a single tree.
examples.zh: 广阔的沙漠延伸数英里，一棵树也没有。

paraphrase_en: ["A firm decision to do or not do something.", "The quality of being determined or resolute.", "A formal expression of opinion or intention by an official body."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 决心，决定。", "n. 坚决，果断。", "n. 决议，正式决定。"]

examples.en: Her New Year's resolution is to exercise more.
examples.zh: 她的新年决心是多锻炼。

examples.en: He showed great resolution in overcoming his challenges.
examples.zh: 他在克服挑战时表现出极大的决心。

examples.en: The UN passed a resolution on climate change.
examples.zh: 联合国通过了一项关于气候变化的决议。

paraphrase_en: ["A group of people living together in a house or flat.", "Relating to the management of a house and home."]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 家庭，户。", "adj. 家用的，家务的。"]

examples.en: The entire household gathered for the holiday dinner.
examples.zh: 全家人聚在一起吃节日大餐。

examples.en: She handles all the household chores efficiently.
examples.zh: 她高效地处理所有家务。

paraphrase_en: ["A smaller number of"]
paraphrase_zh: ["det. 较少的"]

examples.en: There are fewer students in the class this year.
examples.zh: 今年班上的学生更少了。

paraphrase_en: ["The deliberate termination of a pregnancy", "A thing that fails to develop properly"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 人工流产，堕胎", "n. 失败的事物"]

examples.en: She decided to have an abortion.
examples.zh: 她决定进行人工流产。

examples.en: The project was an abortion from the start.
examples.zh: 这个项目从一开始就是个失败。

paraphrase_en: ["Separated by a distance", "Into pieces", "Not including"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 分开地，相距", "adv. 拆开地，成碎片", "adv. 除...以外"]

examples.en: The two cities are 50 miles apart.
examples.zh: 两个城市相距50英里。

examples.en: He took the machine apart to fix it.
examples.zh: 他把机器拆开来修理。

examples.en: Apart from the cost, the plan is excellent.
examples.zh: 除了成本，这个计划非常出色。

paraphrase_en: ["A person who sees an event happen", "To see an event happen"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 目击者", "v. 目睹"]

examples.en: He was a witness to the accident.
examples.zh: 他是事故的目击者。

examples.en: She witnessed the entire event.
examples.zh: 她目睹了整个事件。

paraphrase_en: ["A competitive game or contest", "A person or thing that is similar or equal to another", "To be in harmony or correspondence with"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 比赛，竞赛", "n. 匹配物，对手", "v. 匹配，相配"]

examples.en: The football match ended in a draw.
examples.zh: 足球比赛以平局结束。

examples.en: She found a perfect match for the vase.
examples.zh: 她找到了与花瓶完美匹配的物品。

examples.en: The colors match well.
examples.zh: 颜色很搭配。

paraphrase_en: ["Only just; almost not", "In a simple or sparse way"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adv. 仅仅，几乎不", "adv. 简陋地，勉强地"]

examples.en: He barely passed the exam.
examples.zh: 他勉强通过了考试。

examples.en: The room was barely furnished.
examples.zh: 房间里几乎没有家具。

paraphrase_en: ["An area or portion that is distinct from others", "A distinct part of society or the economy"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 部门，区域", "n. 领域，行业"]

examples.en: They divided the city into different sectors for management.
examples.zh: 他们将城市划分为不同的管理区域。

examples.en: The technology sector is growing rapidly.
examples.zh: 科技行业正在快速增长。

paraphrase_en: ["A person chosen or appointed to act or speak for others", "Serving as a portrayal or symbol of something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 代表，代理人", "adj. 典型的，有代表性的"]

examples.en: She is a representative for the company at the conference.
examples.zh: 她是公司在会议上的代表。

examples.en: This painting is representative of the artist's early work.
examples.zh: 这幅画代表了这位艺术家早期的作品。

paraphrase_en: ["The state of being without or not having enough of something", "To be without or deficient in something"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 缺乏，不足", "v. 缺乏，没有"]

examples.en: There is a lack of water in the region.
examples.zh: 该地区缺水。

examples.en: He lacks confidence in public speaking.
examples.zh: 他在公开演讲中缺乏信心。

paraphrase_en: ["In or to a lower position; under", "In a lower position; below"]
paraphrase_zh: ["prep. 在...下方", "adv. 在下面"]

examples.en: The cat is beneath the table.
examples.zh: 猫在桌子下面。

examples.en: She looked at the stars from the valley beneath.
examples.zh: 她从下面的山谷看星星。

paraphrase_en: ["Next to or at the side of"]
paraphrase_zh: ["prep. 在…旁边"]

examples.en: He sat beside me during the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议期间他坐在我旁边。

paraphrase_en: ["Of the color that is the darkest, like night or coal", "The color that is the darkest, like night or coal"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 黑色的", "n. 黑色"]

examples.en: She wore a black dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件黑色连衣裙去派对。

examples.en: Black is often associated with elegance.
examples.zh: 黑色常与优雅相关联。

paraphrase_en: ["An event or occurrence, especially one that is unusual or unpleasant"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 事件；事故"]

examples.en: The police investigated the incident thoroughly.
examples.zh: 警方彻底调查了这起事件。

paraphrase_en: ["Restricted in extent, number, or scope"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 有限的；受限的"]

examples.en: We have limited time to complete the project.
examples.zh: 我们完成项目的时间有限。

paraphrase_en: ["Feeling pleased and satisfied about something you have done or own"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 自豪的；骄傲的"]

examples.en: She was proud of her son's success.
examples.zh: 她为儿子的成功感到自豪。

paraphrase_en: ["To move or proceed smoothly and continuously", "The action or fact of moving along in a steady, continuous stream"]
paraphrase_zh: ["v. 流动", "n. 流动；流量"]

examples.en: The river flows through the valley.
examples.zh: 河流流经山谷。

examples.en: The flow of traffic was heavy during rush hour.
examples.zh: 高峰时段交通流量很大。

paraphrase_en: ["The body of teachers and academic staff in a university", "A natural physical or mental ability"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 全体教员", "n. 才能；能力"]

examples.en: The faculty voted to change the curriculum.
examples.zh: 全体教员投票更改了课程。

examples.en: He has the faculty of making friends easily.
examples.zh: 他有交朋友的才能。

paraphrase_en: ["Greater in size, amount, or degree", "Past tense of increase; made larger or more in amount"]
paraphrase_zh: ["adj. 增加的", "v. 增加了"]

examples.en: There has been an increased demand for electric vehicles.
examples.zh: 对电动汽车的需求增加了。

examples.en: The company increased its profits last year.
examples.zh: 公司去年增加了利润。

paraphrase_en: ["The act of using something carelessly or without good reason", "To use or expend carelessly or without good reason"]
paraphrase_zh: ["n. 浪费", "v. 浪费；滥用"]

examples.en: Reducing food waste is important.
examples.zh: 减少食物浪费很重要。

examples.en: Don't waste your time on trivial matters.
examples.zh: 不要在小事上浪费时间。
